dimensions.description: Audit watermark for incremental sync (paired with the op's If-Modified-Since parameter). Record-change time, not cash time — bucket cash on date.

dimensions.label: validation errors
dimensions.description: API validation messages retained verbatim for ingestion debugging; empty on healthy reads.

dimensions.label: branding theme id
dimensions.description: Xero's identifier for the theme and the row key; documents reference it via their branding_theme_id.

dimensions.label: name
dimensions.description: Display name of the theme — often a trading name or brand, which is exactly why grouping documents by theme can approximate business units.

dimensions.label: logo url
dimensions.description: Location of the logo image used by the theme; presentation only.

dimensions.label: type
dimensions.description: Always INVOICE per the spec; carried for fidelity, filter on nothing.

dimensions.label: sort order
dimensions.description: Ranked order of themes; 0 marks the org's DEFAULT theme — documents with a null branding_theme_id implicitly use it.

dimensions.label: created date utc
dimensions.description: Creation audit stamp. There is no update watermark — the set is small and fully rescanned each sync.

dimensions.label: budget id
dimensions.description: Owning budget — inherited from the fan-out; always predicate on ONE budget_id or overlapping OVERALL and TRACKING plans double-count.

dimensions.label: account id
dimensions.description: Budgeted account — inherited from the parent budget line; the join to actuals in xero_journal_lines.

dimensions.label: budget balances
dimensions.description: Zero-based position in the line's BudgetBalances array — provenance anchor for the exploded container; chronological within the fetched window, but key on period, not on this.

dimensions.label: period
dimensions.description: Month bucket the amount applies to, as 'YYYY-MM' text (e.g. '2019-08'). Align to actuals with to_char(journal_date, 'YYYY-MM') or cast with to_date(period || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD').

dimensions.label: unit amount
dimensions.description: The spec labels this 'Budgeted amount'; in practice it mirrors amount for monetary budgets. Prefer amount for variance math and treat divergence between the two as a signal to inspect the tenant's payload.

dimensions.label: notes
dimensions.description: Footnotes the budget owner attached to this period's figure — context for anomalous months, not data.

dimensions.label: budget id
dimensions.description: Owning budget — inherited key from the fan-out parent.

dimensions.label: account id
dimensions.description: The budgeted general ledger account — the join that lets budget balances meet actual journal lines account-by-account.

dimensions.label: account code
dimensions.description: The account's code at fetch time — convenience denorm; account_id is the durable identity.

dimensions.label: budget lines
dimensions.description: Zero-based position in the budget's BudgetLines array — provenance anchor for the exploded container; Xero's statement-order listing of the budgeted accounts.

dimensions.label: budget id
dimensions.description: The tracking budget being scoped — inherited key.

dimensions.label: tracking
dimensions.description: Zero-based position in the budget's Tracking array (0 or 1) — provenance anchor for the exploded container.

dimensions.label: tracking category id
dimensions.description: The dimension the budget slices on — join to xero_tracking_categories.

dimensions.label: tracking option id
dimensions.description: The specific option the budget covers — the value actuals must be filtered to via xero_journal_line_tracking for a like-for-like variance.

dimensions.label: name
dimensions.description: Category name at fetch time — display; ids are the join.

dimensions.label: option
dimensions.description: Option label at fetch time — display; group and filter by tracking_option_id.

dimensions.label: budget id
dimensions.description: Xero's budget identifier and the row key; the fan-out parameter for the per-budget line fetch.

dimensions.label: type
dimensions.description: OVERALL is the org-wide plan (exactly one, named 'Overall Budget' in Xero); TRACKING budgets re-plan a tracking slice. Org-level budget-vs-actual uses OVERALL; segment-level uses the matching TRACKING budget — mixing them double-counts the plan.

dimensions.label: description
dimensions.description: The budget's display name as entered in Xero — the only human handle for choosing among multiple tracking budgets.

dimensions.label: updated date utc
dimensions.description: Last edit to the budget — the client-side watermark (the list op has no If-Modified-Since); a change here triggers re-fetching the budget's lines and balances.

dimensions.label: id
dimensions.description: Identifier of the authorization itself (the spec field is literally 'id'). A disconnect/reconnect can mint a new connection_id while tenant_id stays constant — track tenants by tenant_id, not by this.

dimensions.label: connection tenant id
dimensions.description: The Xero tenant UUID — the xero-tenant-id header value scoping every API call, and the join key to xero_organisations.organisation_id (equal for ORGANISATION tenants). This, not connection_id, is the durable identity of the org.

dimensions.label: auth event id
dimensions.description: Shared by every connection granted on the same consent screen — the batch key for multi-org authorizations, and the /Connections filter parameter for 'what did that consent just add'.

dimensions.label: tenant type
dimensions.description: ORGANISATION or PRACTICE (documented informally, not a closed spec enum). Only ORGANISATION tenants have accounting data behind them — PRACTICE rows have no xero_organisations profile and no documents, so unfiltered tenant counts overstate the reporting universe.

dimensions.label: tenant name
dimensions.description: Display name captured at authorization time. It can drift from xero_organisations.name after a rename — prefer the organisation profile's name for labels when a profile row exists.

dimensions.label: created date utc
dimensions.description: When the user first connected this tenant to the app. Data earlier than this exists via backfill, not live capture — useful when judging watermark gaps.

dimensions.label: updated date utc
dimensions.description: Most recent (re)connection time; differs from created_date_utc when the user disconnected and later reconnected. It is consent recency — NOT a data-change watermark for anything inside the org.

dimensions.label: contact id
dimensions.description: Owning contact; with address_type forms the key because Xero returns a fixed-type set rather than an open list.

dimensions.label: address type
dimensions.description: Which fixed slot this row fills. POBOX is the postal/billing address Xero prints on invoices; STREET is the physical/delivery location. 'Where do we bill' and 'where do we ship' are different filters on this column — defaulting to whichever type happens to exist quietly mixes the two.

dimensions.label: city
dimensions.description: City/town as typed by users — unvalidated free text, so expect casing and spelling variants; normalize before grouping.

dimensions.label: region
dimensions.description: State/province/county as free text ('CA', 'California', 'Calif.' all occur). Useful for coarse geography only after normalization.

dimensions.label: country
dimensions.description: Country as free text (letters only, max 50) — NOT ISO codes. 'UK', 'United Kingdom' and 'Great Britain' fragment the same country across group-bys; map to ISO before any country-level rollup, and treat empty string as unknown, not domestic.

dimensions.label: contact id
dimensions.description: The contact this snapshot belongs to; one row per contact, refreshed in place by every scan.

dimensions.label: contact id
dimensions.description: The contact this CIS profile configures, inherited from the fan-out path parameter.

dimensions.label: cis enabled
dimensions.description: Marks the contact as a CIS subcontractor for a UK construction org. Only meaningful where rows exist at all: a missing row in a non-UK org is jurisdictional absence, not false, so left-join semantics matter when flagging subcontractors.

dimensions.label: contact group id
dimensions.description: The group side of the edge, inherited from the fan-out parent.

dimensions.label: contact id
dimensions.description: The contact side of the edge, from the membership stub Xero nests in the group response. Join xero_contacts for everything beyond identity — the stub carries only id and name.

dimensions.label: contact group id
dimensions.description: Xero's identifier for the group and the fan-out parameter that fetches its members.

dimensions.label: name
dimensions.description: The segment label as the org typed it. This is business vocabulary, not system vocabulary — surface it verbatim in answers, and expect renames to change history-free (there is no audit trail).

dimensions.label: status
dimensions.description: Declares ACTIVE/DELETED, but list GETs return only ACTIVE groups — DELETED ones vanish from responses rather than arriving flagged. Expect only ACTIVE in staging; a group's deletion shows up as its id disappearing on identity diff, at which point the platform tombstones the row.

dimensions.label: contacts
dimensions.description: The ContactID and Name of Contacts in a contact group. Returned on GETs when the ContactGroupID is supplied in the URL. Retained verbatim as the raw array Xero returned: the declared element order is part of the document and is lost by flattening. Fully normalised into xero_contact_group_members (one row per element) — join there for anything you filter or aggregate on, and read this column only when the original ordering or an unflattened payload matters.

dimensions.label: contact id
dimensions.description: Owning contact. Half of the key, because Xero gives contact persons no id of their own.

dimensions.label: person ordinal
dimensions.description: Zero-based position in the ContactPersons array — stable only until the list is edited, when Xero silently reshuffles it. Treat (contact_id, person_ordinal) as a current-state key; never build slowly-changing person history on it.

dimensions.label: include in emails
dimensions.description: Whether Xero CCs this person on emailed documents (invoices, statements). 'Who receives our invoices' = the contact's primary email UNION rows here where this is true — filtering on it is what separates recipients from mere directory entries.

dimensions.label: contact id
dimensions.description: Owning contact; with phone_type forms the key over Xero's fixed slot set.

dimensions.label: phone type
dimensions.description: Which fixed slot this is: DEFAULT is the number Xero surfaces in its UI, DDI is a direct-dial line, plus MOBILE, FAX and OFFICE. Pick MOBILE for SMS-reachability questions and DEFAULT for 'the' phone number — scanning all types per contact double-counts people.

dimensions.label: contact id
dimensions.description: Xero's immutable identifier for the contact and the join target of every document table — invoices, credit notes, payments, bank transactions and purchase orders all carry it. Survives renames and archiving; after a merge the losing id remains on this shell row while documents move to the survivor, so group by COALESCE(merged_to_contact_id, contact_id) when counting business entities across full history.

dimensions.label: merged to contact id
dimensions.description: Non-null marks this row as the losing side of a contact merge, pointing at the surviving contact that now owns the relationship and its documents. Xero archives the loser at merge time, so these rows also carry contact_status='ARCHIVED'. Only populated on paged or by-id fetches — the scan plan pages, so it is reliable in staging. Counting contacts without collapsing through this column overstates how many customers or suppliers exist.

dimensions.label: contact number
dimensions.description: Shown as 'Contact Code' in the Xero UI but writable only through the API — which makes it the strongest cross-system identity hint on the record, because integrations (POS, CRM, ecommerce) park their own ids here. Try matching on this before resorting to fuzzy name matching. Distinct from account_number, which users edit freely.

dimensions.label: account number
dimensions.description: A user-maintained reference editable in both the UI and API. Weaker than contact_number as an identity hint precisely because humans repurpose it — expect blanks, duplicates and recycled values; never assume uniqueness.

dimensions.label: contact status
dimensions.description: Directory lifecycle gate. The scan passes includeArchived=true, so ARCHIVED rows — including every merge loser — persist in staging even though Xero's UI and default API responses hide them; any live-directory count must filter ACTIVE. GDPRREQUEST marks a contact under a GDPR erasure request: exclude it from outreach, enrichment or any surfaced PII immediately, and treat its identity fields as scheduled for removal rather than durable.

dimensions.label: company number
dimensions.description: Company registration number (Companies House / ASIC style) — a public-registry identifier, not a tax number. The best hook for firmographic enrichment and legal-entity dedupe when populated, which is rarely.

dimensions.label: tax number type
dimensions.description: Regional qualifier for tax_number; the values the spec declares (SSN, EIN, ITIN, ATIN) are all US identifiers, so expect it mostly null outside US orgs. SSN or ITIN means the adjacent tax_number identifies a person, not a company, and inherits that sensitivity.

dimensions.label: accounts receivable tax type
dimensions.description: Contact-level default TaxType applied to new SALES lines for this contact at document-creation time only. Historical lines carry their own TaxType — never recompute tax by joining this backwards onto documents. Joins xero_tax_rates.tax_type.

dimensions.label: accounts payable tax type
dimensions.description: Default TaxType for new PURCHASE (bill) lines from this contact. Same caveat as the AR twin: creation-time default, not document truth. Joins xero_tax_rates.tax_type.

dimensions.label: is supplier
dimensions.description: Derived, read-only evidence flag: true once ANY accounts-payable invoice (bill) has ever been raised against the contact. It is history, not declaration — a vendor you have only sent purchase orders to stays false, and the flag never reverts. Not exclusive with is_customer; both true is common and legitimate.

dimensions.label: is customer
dimensions.description: Derived, read-only evidence flag: true once ANY accounts-receivable invoice has ever been raised for the contact. Prospects with only quotes show false, so 'customer list' by this flag means invoiced-at-least-once, not CRM-customer. Never reverts, never set by users.

dimensions.label: sales default line amount type
dimensions.description: Default LineAmountTypes proposed on new sales documents for this contact (whether line amounts include tax). Config only — every document stores its own LineAmountTypes, which is what tax math must read. Only returned when summaryOnly or paging is used or on by-id fetches; the paged scan keeps it populated.

dimensions.label: purchases default line amount type
dimensions.description: Default LineAmountTypes for new purchase documents from this contact. Same contract as the sales twin: creation-time default, present only under summaryOnly, paged or by-id fetches, never a substitute for the document's own value.

dimensions.label: default currency
dimensions.description: ISO 4217 code Xero PROPOSES for new documents to this contact — not a guarantee that the contact's documents are in it, since each document carries its own CurrencyCode. Use it for directory-level currency mix and as the reading frame for xero_contact_balances, whose amounts are raw and unconverted. The spec's CurrencyCode enum is very long; join ledger_config's xero_currencies for the codes this org actually subscribes to.

dimensions.label: xero network key
dimensions.description: Xero-to-Xero network invitation key enabling e-invoicing between two Xero orgs. Operational plumbing with no analytical meaning; retained for lossless staging and as weak evidence the counterparty also runs Xero.

dimensions.label: sales default account code
dimensions.description: Default revenue account CODE — Xero account codes are org-editable text, not AccountID uuids — proposed on new sales lines for this contact. Lines store their own AccountCode, so this explains coding behaviour, never actual postings. Joins xero_accounts.code.

dimensions.label: purchases default account code
dimensions.description: Default expense account CODE proposed on new purchase lines from this contact. Same contract as the sales twin: a creation-time default keyed by code, joined via xero_accounts.code, never a source of historical postings.

dimensions.label: sales tracking categories
dimensions.description: Default tracking category/option pairs (TrackingCategoryName + TrackingOptionName entries) proposed on new SALES lines for this contact, verbatim from the API. Real dimensional analysis lives on document line tracking joined to ledger_config's xero_tracking_categories — attributing revenue to a tracking option from this default is wrong whenever users override at entry time, which is exactly when tracking is interesting. Carries the contact-default tracking assignments verbatim: each element is a SalesTrackingCategory pair (TrackingCategoryName, TrackingOptionName) applied to new sales documents for this contact.

dimensions.label: purchases tracking categories
dimensions.description: Default tracking category/option pairs proposed on new PURCHASE lines from this contact, verbatim from the API. Same warning as the sales twin: a default, not what actually landed on any line. Same SalesTrackingCategory pair shape as the sales default, applied to new purchase documents.

dimensions.label: tracking category name
dimensions.description: Flattened convenience mirror of the category name inside the Sales/PurchasesTrackingCategories defaults — a write-side echo, redundant with the jsonb columns and silent about which side (sales or purchases) it came from. Prefer the jsonb defaults for config questions and line-level tracking for real analysis.

dimensions.label: tracking category option
dimensions.description: Flattened mirror of the tracking OPTION inside the contact's default tracking assignment, with the same ambiguity as tracking_category_name. Never treat it as a per-document dimension value.

dimensions.label: payment terms
dimensions.description: Default terms Xero uses to compute DueDate on NEW documents, shaped {Bills:{Day,Type},Sales:{Day,Type}} — Bills governs what you owe this contact (purchases), Sales governs what they owe you. Type is one of DAYSAFTERBILLDATE, DAYSAFTERBILLMONTH, OFCURRENTMONTH, OFFOLLOWINGMONTH (the org-owned PaymentTerm/Bill objects) and Day is the day count or day-of-month that Type interprets. Defaults only: the binding due date is each document's own DueDate. Filter like (payment_terms #>> '{Bills,Day}')::int = 30.

dimensions.label: updated date utc
dimensions.description: Xero's last-modified stamp and the incremental watermark for the contact scan. It is NOT a creation date — Xero exposes none for contacts — so 'new customers this month' cannot come from here; derive first-seen from the earliest document date instead. Bulk imports and API integrations bump it in clusters, so distributions over this column describe sync behaviour, not business activity.

dimensions.label: contact groups
dimensions.description: Inline membership stubs (ContactGroupID + Name entries) exactly as Xero returns them on the contact. The queryable membership edge is xero_contact_group_members, built from the per-group fan-out — join there. Keep this only to reconcile the two sides when fan-out lag is suspected; parsing it in analytical SQL is a smell.

dimensions.label: website
dimensions.description: Read-only website URL — a handy firmographic-enrichment hint and nothing more. No lifecycle or financial meaning.

dimensions.label: branding theme branding theme id
dimensions.description: The invoice branding theme this contact defaults to, lifted one hop from the nested BrandingTheme stub. Join xero_branding_themes for the theme's name; when a document carries its own BrandingThemeID, the document wins — this is only the default.

dimensions.label: balances
dimensions.description: Verbatim raw AR/AP outstanding-and-overdue snapshot block exactly as Xero returned it on this sync — the audit copy behind xero_contact_balances, which is the queryable, typed form and the one analytical SQL should read. Kept verbatim because the snapshot is overwritten in place every scan: when the typed table looks wrong, this payload is the only record of precisely what Xero reported. Amounts inside are raw document-currency sums, never converted to base.

dimensions.label: discount
dimensions.description: Default percentage discount pre-filled on new sales lines for this contact (read-only here). It is a RATE: never sum it, never multiply it against historical revenue — realized discounts live on invoice lines, where users freely override this default.

dimensions.label: attachments
dimensions.description: Inline attachment stubs as Xero happens to return them — not reliably populated on list scans and never a complete inventory. The governed attachment catalog is org_meta's xero_attachments fan-out; use has_attachments to decide which contacts merit that rate-limited call. Counting files from this column undercounts.

dimensions.label: has attachments
dimensions.description: Cheap scan-time signal that at least one file hangs off the contact — the prioritization key for the rate-limited attachments fan-out. True here with no rows yet in xero_attachments means the fan-out simply has not run, not that data is missing.

dimensions.label: validation errors
dimensions.description: Write-path artifact: Xero populates this on responses to failed or partial POSTs, so on read scans it is effectively always empty. Non-empty values in staging mean a write response was replayed into the pipeline — investigate the ingest, do not analyze the content.

dimensions.label: has validation errors
dimensions.description: Companion flag to validation_errors with the same write-path-only lifecycle. Expect false/null everywhere on read scans; it carries no directory meaning.

dimensions.label: status attribute string
dimensions.description: Response-status marker from write calls (the OK/ERROR family). Not a contact lifecycle field — that is contact_status — and never meaningful on read scans; staged for losslessness only.

dimensions.label: addresses
dimensions.description: Store certain address types for a contact – see address types Retained verbatim so the founding canonical mapper keeps reading the column it was written against.

dimensions.label: phones
dimensions.description: Store certain phone types for a contact – see phone types Retained verbatim so the founding canonical mapper keeps reading the column it was written against.

dimensions.label: contact persons
dimensions.description: See contact persons Retained verbatim so the founding canonical mapper keeps reading the column it was written against.

dimensions.label: branding theme
dimensions.description: Contact.BrandingTheme as returned by the pinned OpenAPI. Retained verbatim so the founding canonical mapper keeps reading the column it was written against.

dimensions.label: credit note id
dimensions.description: Parent credit note being spent; join xero_credit_notes for type, status and currency — an allocation from a VOIDED credit note is history, not a live offset.

dimensions.label: allocations
dimensions.description: Zero-based position within the parent's Allocations array (provenance: the array itself — the ordinal is its index). The spec exposes no allocation identifier, so parent id + position forms the row key; positions renumber when allocations are removed, and the ingester replaces the set per parent rescan.

dimensions.label: allocations invoice invoice id
dimensions.description: The invoice this slice of credit was applied to; join xero_invoices. The invoice's amount_due already reflects the allocation — subtracting it again double-nets.

dimensions.label: allocations date
dimensions.description: The date the allocation takes effect — this, not the credit note's issue date, is when the target invoice's balance dropped. Aging and as-of AR reconstructions must use it.

dimensions.label: line items line item id
dimensions.description: Xero's identifier for the credited line and the row key. Like invoice lines, edits that resubmit the line set without LineItemIDs recreate the lines under new ids — line identity is not durable across every edit.

dimensions.label: credit note id
dimensions.description: Parent credit note key. Join xero_credit_notes for type (ACCRECCREDIT vs ACCPAYCREDIT), status, currency and line_amount_types — without it this row cannot be signed or filtered correctly.

dimensions.label: line items
dimensions.description: Zero-based position within the parent's LineItems array (provenance: the array itself). Presentation order only; renumbered on edit.

dimensions.label: line items description
dimensions.description: Free-text description of what is being credited; description-only lines (null amounts) are legal and carry narrative, not value.

dimensions.label: line items quantity
dimensions.description: Units credited (positive). For units-returned analysis, negate when netting against invoiced quantity.

dimensions.label: line items unit amount
dimensions.description: Per-unit price being credited, document currency. A rate — never summed; credited value is line_amount.

dimensions.label: line items tax type
dimensions.description: Tax rate key being reversed on the line; join xero_tax_rates.tax_type.

dimensions.label: line items tax amount
dimensions.description: Tax reversed on this line, document currency. Auto-calculated but overridable — trust the stored value over any recomputation.

dimensions.label: line items account code
dimensions.description: GL account code the credit posts against — usually the same revenue/expense account the original invoice line hit; join xero_accounts.code.

dimensions.label: line items account id
dimensions.description: Immutable GL account id for the credited line; the durable join to xero_accounts.

dimensions.label: line items item code
dimensions.description: Catalogue item code being credited; null on free-typed credit lines. Return-rate analysis joining only on item_code misses free-typed credits.

dimensions.label: line items item item id
dimensions.description: Resolved catalogue item id from the embedded Item echo; the durable join to xero_items.

dimensions.label: line items item
dimensions.description: Verbatim item stub ({Code, Name, ItemID}) as credited at sync time; prefer scalar item_id/item_code for joins.

dimensions.label: line items tracking
dimensions.description: Up to 2 tracking assignments ({TrackingCategoryID, TrackingOptionID, Name, Option}) — credits carry tracking too, and department/region views that ignore credit-note tracking overstate every tracked segment. Expand with jsonb_array_elements; join xero_tracking_options.

dimensions.label: line items discount rate
dimensions.description: Carried for shape-compatibility with the shared LineItem schema, but Xero does not support discounts on credit notes — expect null.

dimensions.label: line items discount amount
dimensions.description: Carried for shape-compatibility; discounts are unsupported on credit notes — expect null.

dimensions.label: line items repeating invoice id
dimensions.description: Repeating-template lineage carried on the shared line schema; effectively always null on credit notes.

dimensions.label: line items taxability
dimensions.description: US automated sales tax classification of the credited line; null outside US orgs.

dimensions.label: line items sales tax code id
dimensions.description: Internal id of the US sales tax code on the line; US orgs only.

dimensions.label: line items tax breakdown
dimensions.description: Per-jurisdiction US sales tax components reversed by this line, kept verbatim; tax_amount already totals them.

dimensions.label: credit note id
dimensions.description: Xero's immutable identifier for the credit note and the row key.

dimensions.label: type
dimensions.description: Direction of the credit: ACCRECCREDIT credits a customer (reduces revenue/AR), ACCPAYCREDIT is a supplier crediting the org (reduces spend/AP). Same trap as invoices — any 'credits issued' number without a type filter mixes both directions.

dimensions.label: status
dimensions.description: Same lifecycle as invoices: DRAFT/SUBMITTED unapproved, AUTHORISED live, PAID fully consumed, VOIDED/DELETED dead but still returned by the API. Real credit exposure = status IN ('AUTHORISED','PAID'); unapplied exposure adds remaining_credit > 0.

dimensions.label: contact contact id
dimensions.description: The customer being credited (ACCRECCREDIT) or the supplier crediting the org (ACCPAYCREDIT); join xero_contacts.

dimensions.label: credit note number
dimensions.description: Human-facing number, auto-generated from org settings for ACCRECCREDIT; supplier credit numbers are keyed by hand. Display only — not unique, not a join key.

dimensions.label: reference
dimensions.description: Additional free-text reference, ACCRECCREDIT only; null on supplier credits.

dimensions.label: date
dimensions.description: Issue date of the credit — the accrual date that reduces revenue/spend in the period. Defaults to the org-timezone current date when omitted at creation.

dimensions.label: due date
dimensions.description: Due date carried on the document; largely ceremonial for credits — credit notes settle by allocation or refund, not by falling due.

dimensions.label: line amount types
dimensions.description: Whether the credit note's line amounts include tax (Exclusive/Inclusive/NoTax). Header sub_total/total_tax/total are normalized; line-level sums must respect this flag exactly as on invoices.

dimensions.label: currency code
dimensions.description: ISO 4217 currency of all monetary fields on this credit note (spec CurrencyCode enum; extraction truncates the full list — treat no subset as exhaustive). Never sum across currencies without converting.

dimensions.label: total tax
dimensions.description: Total tax being reversed by the credit, in document currency.

dimensions.label: applied amount
dimensions.description: Amount of this credit already applied against invoices. The per-invoice detail — which invoice, when, how much — is xero_credit_note_allocations; analyze application behaviour there.

dimensions.label: fully paid on date
dimensions.description: Date the credit was fully consumed (allocated and/or refunded); null while any remaining_credit exists.

dimensions.label: cis deduction
dimensions.description: UK Construction Industry Scheme deduction reversed by this credit; null outside CIS-enabled UK orgs.

dimensions.label: cis rate
dimensions.description: CIS deduction percentage for the org — a rate, never summed.

dimensions.label: sent to contact
dimensions.description: Marked-as-sent flag inside Xero; settable only on approved credit notes. Does not prove delivery.

dimensions.label: branding theme id
dimensions.description: Template/branding used for the document; join xero_branding_themes.

dimensions.label: has attachments
dimensions.description: True when files are attached; the files are catalogued in xero_attachments (org_meta).

dimensions.label: has errors
dimensions.description: True when the payload carried validation errors — sync/data-quality signal, not a business state.

dimensions.label: status attribute string
dimensions.description: Batch-response status indicator accompanying validation messages; ignore for analytics.

dimensions.label: updated date utc
dimensions.description: Last-modified audit stamp and the incremental-sync watermark; not a business date.

dimensions.label: updated date utc string
dimensions.description: ISO-8601 string twin of updated_date_utc; prefer the parsed timestamp column.

dimensions.label: payments
dimensions.description: Read-only echo of CASH REFUNDS paid out against this credit note. Authoritative refund rows live in xero_payments with their refund PaymentTypes — a refund is money out the door, distinct from an allocation which merely offsets an invoice.

dimensions.label: validation errors
dimensions.description: API validation error messages carried verbatim ({Message} objects); data-quality triage only.

dimensions.label: warnings
dimensions.description: Non-fatal API warning messages ({Message} objects).

dimensions.label: contact
dimensions.description: CreditNote.Contact as returned by the pinned OpenAPI. Retained verbatim so the founding canonical mapper keeps reading the column it was written against.

dimensions.label: line items
dimensions.description: See Invoice Line Items Retained verbatim so the founding canonical mapper keeps reading the column it was written against.

dimensions.label: allocations
dimensions.description: See Allocations Retained verbatim so the founding canonical mapper keeps reading the column it was written against.

dimensions.label: code
dimensions.description: ISO 4217 code and the row key — the value document CurrencyCode columns join on. The spec enum is the full ISO set; the extracted list is truncated at HRK, so treat later codes as valid.

dimensions.label: description
dimensions.description: Display name of the currency ('United States Dollar') — presentation only.

dimensions.label: payment id
dimensions.description: Xero's payment identifier and the row key, globally unique across the org and stable across syncs (unlike line ids, the embedded payment array is never rewritten wholesale). Do not expect the id to resolve in xero_payments — that endpoint serves only payments allocated to invoices, credit notes, prepayments and overpayments.

dimensions.label: expense claim id
dimensions.description: The claim this reimbursement pays down; joins xero_expense_claims for the employee and due date.

dimensions.label: payment ordinal
dimensions.description: Zero-based position within the claim's embedded Payments array; preserves application order when several part-payments settle one claim.

dimensions.label: date
dimensions.description: The date the reimbursement was paid — the settlement date for cycle-time and monthly cash-out analysis.

dimensions.label: reference
dimensions.description: Free-text payment reference (bank memo, batch note); display and matching aid only.

dimensions.label: status
dimensions.description: AUTHORISED is a live reimbursement; DELETED is a reversed one that Xero keeps returning — it un-pays the claim (amount_due goes back up) so every cash sum must filter AUTHORISED.

dimensions.label: payment type
dimensions.description: The shared Payment type vocabulary. For rows in this table the type is incidental — membership here already scopes them to expense-claim reimbursements; do not filter this column to find them.

dimensions.label: updated date utc
dimensions.description: Modification stamp of the embedded payment record; rows still arrive via the parent claim scan, so this is diagnostic rather than a scan watermark.

dimensions.label: expense claim id
dimensions.description: The claim this receipt was submitted on; joins xero_expense_claims for status and reimbursement amounts.

dimensions.label: receipt id
dimensions.description: The receipt submitted on this claim; joins xero_receipts for merchant, employee and totals, and onward to xero_receipt_line_items for GL detail.

dimensions.label: receipt ordinal
dimensions.description: Zero-based position of the receipt within the claim's embedded array; preserves submission order for display and diffing.

dimensions.label: expense claim id
dimensions.description: Xero's immutable identifier for the claim and the row key; the join key for its receipts and reimbursement payments.

dimensions.label: status
dimensions.description: Reimbursement lifecycle: SUBMITTED awaits approval, AUTHORISED is an approved liability, PAID is settled, VOIDED/DELETED are dead yet still returned by the API. 'What do we owe employees' is status = 'AUTHORISED' — there is no DRAFT at claim level; drafts exist as unclaimed receipts.

dimensions.label: user user id
dimensions.description: The org user (employee) who submitted the claim and is owed the reimbursement; joins xero_users. The person axis of employee-spend analysis.

dimensions.label: payment due date
dimensions.description: Date the reimbursement is due to the employee. Overdue liability = AUTHORISED claims with amount_due > 0 past this date.

dimensions.label: reporting date
dimensions.description: Accounting date the claim reports under in Xero — the period axis for expense reporting, distinct from when receipts were spent and from when reimbursement happens.

dimensions.label: receipt id
dimensions.description: Write-side convenience identifier of a single associated receipt echoed by the API. Unreliable on reads — the authoritative claim-to-receipt mapping is xero_expense_claim_receipts; never aggregate through this column.

dimensions.label: updated date utc
dimensions.description: Server-side modification stamp and the incremental-sync watermark (If-Modified-Since); audit metadata, not a business date.

dimensions.label: receipts
dimensions.description: Retained verbatim as the raw array Xero returned: the declared element order is part of the document and is lost by flattening. Fully normalised into xero_expense_claim_receipts (one row per element) — join there for anything you filter or aggregate on, and read this column only when the original ordering or an unflattened payload matters.

dimensions.label: payments
dimensions.description: See Payments Retained verbatim as the raw array Xero returned: the declared element order is part of the document and is lost by flattening. Fully normalised into xero_expense_claim_payments (one row per element) — join there for anything you filter or aggregate on, and read this column only when the original ordering or an unflattened payload matters.

dimensions.label: file id
dimensions.description: UUID of the attached file and one half of the row key. Join to xero_files for name, content type, size and uploader — always populated there, unlike this table's per-object-endpoint denormalized copies.

dimensions.label: object id
dimensions.description: UUID of the business record the file evidences (an InvoiceID, BankTransactionID, ContactID, ... depending on object_group) and the other half of the row key. It is polymorphic: joining it to any table without first filtering object_group silently discards every other group's rows and understates attachment coverage.

dimensions.label: object group
dimensions.description: Coarse family of the attached-to record and the join router: Invoice rows join xero_invoices, BankTransaction rows join xero_bank_transactions, and so on across twelve families. Always constrain it before joining or before counting 'attachments per document' — the table mixes all families at one grain.

dimensions.label: object type
dimensions.description: Finer classification of the target. For Invoice-group rows it distinguishes AccRec (sales invoice) from Accpay (bill) — Xero's ACCREC/ACCPAY split that governs every revenue-vs-spend question, available here without a join. The vocabulary is shared across families: Account-group rows carry account classes (Bank, Equity, Currliab, ...), and spellings like Prepayment, Receipt or Contact recur with family-specific meanings — never interpret it without object_group beside it.

dimensions.label: send with object
dimensions.description: Whether the file rides along on client-facing sends of its document (e.g. goes out with the emailed invoice). Only GET /Associations/{ObjectId} returns it, so under the bulk per-file scan it is NULL — meaning unknown, not 'no'. Any count of client-visible attachments must exclude NULLs explicitly or it fabricates an answer.

dimensions.label: name
dimensions.description: Denormalized copy of the attached file's name that only the per-object endpoint supplies — NULL under the bulk scan. Prefer xero_files.name via file_id: populated for every row and current after renames.

dimensions.label: size
dimensions.description: Denormalized byte size of the attached file, per-object-endpoint-only (NULL under the bulk scan). Never a storage measure even when populated: a file attached to three records appears three times — storage questions belong on xero_files.size_bytes.

dimensions.label: created date utc
dimensions.description: When the underlying FILE was created (its upload moment), not when it was attached — attachment timing is association_date_utc, and confusing the two misstates evidence timelines. Per-object-endpoint-only (NULL under the bulk scan); xero_files.created_date_utc is the always-populated equivalent.

dimensions.label: association date utc
dimensions.description: The attachment moment (UTC) — the only field anywhere that says when evidence was linked to its record ('was the receipt attached before month-end close?'). Only the per-object endpoint returns it, so bulk-scanned rows hold NULL and timing analyses require a targeted per-object refresh first.

dimensions.label: id
dimensions.description: Immutable UUID of the file and the row key; xero_file_associations.file_id points here. Names repeat freely — the same PDF uploaded twice is two distinct ids — so dedupe and join on this, never on name.

dimensions.label: folder id
dimensions.description: UUID of the containing folder — every file lives in exactly one. The workflow test is joining xero_folders and checking is_inbox: Inbox membership separates filed documents from paperwork still awaiting attention.

dimensions.label: name
dimensions.description: Display label with extension, as uploaded or emailed in and possibly renamed later. Cosmetic only: not unique, not stable, and its extension can disagree with mime_type — identity is file_id and content classification is mime_type.

dimensions.label: mime type
dimensions.description: Content type recorded at upload (application/pdf, image/png, image/jpeg, ...) and the practical way to slice documents — scans and receipts vs spreadsheets. It is recorded metadata, not a verified property of the bytes: the spec documents example values, not a content-check, so treat generic entries like application/octet-stream as classification gaps and expect occasional disagreement with the extension in name.

dimensions.label: size
dimensions.description: Storage footprint in bytes. Safe to SUM — each row is one stored object — which makes this, not the per-attachment copy in xero_file_associations.file_size_bytes, the source for storage questions; that copy repeats once per record the file is attached to.

dimensions.label: created date utc
dimensions.description: When the file entered Xero (upload or email-in moment, UTC) — NOT the business date of the paper it depicts: a March receipt scanned in July is a July row here. 'What did we digitize last month' uses this; expense or revenue timing never does — that lives on the accounting document the file is associated to.

dimensions.label: updated date utc
dimensions.description: Metadata-change stamp (rename, move between folders) and this table's watermark field — but the Files API accepts no modified-since or where filter, so it powers local delta detection after a full sweep rather than server-side incremental pulls.

dimensions.label: user id
dimensions.description: The uploader's Xero user UUID — files:User.Id reached through the FileObject.User ref; the spec labels it only 'Xero identifier'. In practice it matches the org's Xero login identity, so a LEFT JOIN to xero_users.user_id decorates uploads with directory detail — but treat non-matches (departed users; the cross-API identity is observed behavior, not a spec guarantee) as expected, never as broken data.

dimensions.label: id
dimensions.description: Folder UUID and the row key; xero_files.folder_id points here. Stable across renames — group by this and decorate with name, or a rename fragments history.

dimensions.label: name
dimensions.description: Folder label as shown in Xero ('Inbox', 'Contracts', ...). Users can rename any folder except the Inbox at any time, so it is presentation, not identity.

dimensions.label: email
dimensions.description: The magic email-in address: anything mailed to it lands as a file in the Inbox. Only the Inbox row carries a value — NULL for every other folder. It is a machine-minted org capability address (how users forward supplier bills into Xero), not a person's mailbox, which is why it is deliberately not flagged pii.

dimensions.label: is inbox
dimensions.description: Marks the single system Inbox — undeletable, unrenamable, the landing zone for emailed and unfiled documents. 'Paperwork awaiting processing' means files whose folder has this flag set; treating the Inbox as just another folder turns backlog questions into noise.

dimensions.label: parent endpoint
dimensions.description: Namespace half of the polymorphic parent key; the trail mixes every history-capable endpoint in one table, so filter it before joining or counting anything.

dimensions.label: parent id
dimensions.description: UUID of the document/contact whose audit trail this event belongs to; join to the endpoint's staging table under the parent_endpoint filter.

dimensions.label: ordinal
dimensions.description: Minted tie-breaker, NOT a stable event id: new events prepend, so yesterday's ordinal 0 is today's 1, and every refresh reassigns positions (replace-per-parent). Use date_utc for ordering and never persist references to ordinal.

dimensions.label: details
dimensions.description: Human-readable event prose ('INV-0042 sent to Acme.', note bodies). Free text intended for display — pattern-match it for context, never parse amounts or dates out of it.

dimensions.label: changes
dimensions.description: Short event-type label ('Created', 'Approved', 'Voided', 'Edited', 'Note'...). The OpenAPI's own description of this field is a copy-paste artifact ('Name of branding theme') — ignore it. The vocabulary is uncontrolled, so hunt event types with ILIKE patterns rather than strict equality.

dimensions.label: date utc
dimensions.description: UTC timestamp of the event and the only trustworthy ordering key for the trail. An audit stamp, not a business date — bucket into local days via the org's timezone when users expect calendar-day grouping.

dimensions.label: line items line item id
dimensions.description: Xero's identifier for the line and the row key. Not guaranteed durable: an update that resubmits the invoice's lines without their LineItemIDs deletes and recreates them under new ids, so never diff line history across syncs by this key alone.

dimensions.label: invoice id
dimensions.description: Parent document key. The join to xero_invoices is mandatory: type (ACCREC/ACCPAY), status, currency_code, currency_rate and line_amount_types all live there and all change what this row means.

dimensions.label: line items
dimensions.description: Zero-based position of the line within the parent's LineItems array (provenance: the array itself — the ordinal is its index). Presentation order for document reconstruction; re-numbered whenever the invoice is edited, so never use it as a stable identity.

dimensions.label: line items description
dimensions.description: Free-text line description (min 1 char). Xero allows description-only lines with no quantity or amounts — they carry narrative, not value, and must be excluded from unit economics (quantity IS NULL).

dimensions.label: line items quantity
dimensions.description: Units billed, up to 4dp; null on description-only lines. Only additive within a single item/unit definition — summing quantity across unrelated items adds hours to widgets.

dimensions.label: line items tax type
dimensions.description: Tax rate key applied to the line; join xero_tax_rates.tax_type for the rate's name and percentage. Org-specific vocabulary (OUTPUT2, NONE, ...), not a fixed enum.

dimensions.label: line items account code
dimensions.description: User-facing GL account code the line posts to (join xero_accounts.code). Codes are org-editable — prefer account_id for durable joins.

dimensions.label: line items account id
dimensions.description: Immutable GL account identifier for the line; the safe join to xero_accounts. Which account a line posts to is what separates product revenue from freight, interest or clearing noise.

dimensions.label: line items item code
dimensions.description: User-defined code of the catalogue item behind the line; null on free-typed lines (very common on ACCPAY bills). Product analytics that drops null item_code silently ignores non-catalogue billing.

dimensions.label: line items item item id
dimensions.description: Resolved Xero identifier of the catalogue item (from the embedded Item echo); the durable join to xero_items — item_code can be renamed, this cannot.

dimensions.label: line items item
dimensions.description: Verbatim item stub as billed at sync time ({Code, Name, ItemID}). Point-in-time snapshot of the item's identity; use scalar item_id/item_code for joins and xero_items for current attributes.

dimensions.label: line items tracking
dimensions.description: Up to 2 tracking assignments — the org's self-defined analysis dimensions (Region, Department, ...) — as an array of {TrackingCategoryID, TrackingOptionID, Name, Option}. Expand with jsonb_array_elements and join xero_tracking_options on TrackingOptionID. Lines with no entry for a category are 'unassigned' and must not be dropped from breakdowns.

dimensions.label: line items discount rate
dimensions.description: Percentage discount on the line — supported on ACCREC invoices only (Xero does not discount ACCPAY bills or credit notes). A rate, never summed; the money effect is already inside line_amount.

dimensions.label: line items discount amount
dimensions.description: Absolute discount applied (ACCREC invoices and quotes only). line_amount is already net of it — subtracting again undercounts revenue; discount given = SUM(discount_amount) plus rate-based discounts.

dimensions.label: line items repeating invoice id
dimensions.description: Repeating template this line originated from when the parent was generated by a schedule; null on one-off documents.

dimensions.label: line items taxability
dimensions.description: US automated sales tax classification of the line; null outside US orgs. PART_TAXABLE lines split their base — see tax_breakdown for the jurisdictional detail.

dimensions.label: line items sales tax code id
dimensions.description: Internal id of the US sales tax code applied to the line; US automated sales tax orgs only.

dimensions.label: line items tax breakdown
dimensions.description: Per-jurisdiction US sales tax components (state/county/city/special district) with rate, tax and taxable/non-taxable/exempt bases. Genuinely polymorphic per jurisdiction, kept verbatim; the line's total tax is already in tax_amount — summing components AND tax_amount double-counts.

dimensions.label: settings key
dimensions.description: Minted singleton key so the row has a stable identity; always the literal 'invoice_reminders'.

dimensions.label: enabled
dimensions.description: True when automatic invoice reminder emails are on for the org. Context for DSO/collections analysis, not a per-invoice fact — Xero does not expose which invoices actually received reminders.

dimensions.label: invoice id
dimensions.description: Xero's immutable identifier for the document and the row key; stable across edits, payment and voiding. The only safe join key — invoice_number is not unique.

dimensions.label: type
dimensions.description: The single most important filter in the Xero connector: ACCREC is a sales invoice (receivable), ACCPAY is a bill you owe (payable). GET /Invoices only ever returns those two — the other six enum values are the credit-note/prepayment/overpayment shapes surfaced by their own endpoints. Any revenue or spend number that does not filter type mixes sales with purchases and is wrong.

dimensions.label: status
dimensions.description: Lifecycle gate for every aggregate. DRAFT/SUBMITTED are unapproved, AUTHORISED is approved and open, PAID is settled; VOIDED and DELETED are dead documents the API keeps returning. Billed revenue = status IN ('AUTHORISED','PAID'); including VOIDED resurrects cancelled sales, including DRAFT counts things that never happened.

dimensions.label: contact contact id
dimensions.description: The customer (ACCREC) or supplier (ACCPAY) on the document; join xero_contacts. The same contact can play both roles on different documents — direction always comes from type, never from the contact.

dimensions.label: invoice number
dimensions.description: Human-facing document number (max 255). Auto-generated for ACCREC from org invoice settings; on ACCPAY it is whatever was keyed from the supplier's paper and is neither unique nor reliably present. Display and lookup only — never a join key.

dimensions.label: reference
dimensions.description: Free-text reference, ACCREC only (typically the customer's PO number); null on bills.

dimensions.label: date
dimensions.description: Issue date (org-timezone business date) — the accrual date that revenue and spend reports bucket on. Not the payment date; cash timing lives in xero_payments.

dimensions.label: due date
dimensions.description: Contractual due date. Overdue receivables = type='ACCREC' AND status='AUTHORISED' AND amount_due > 0 AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE.

dimensions.label: line amount types
dimensions.description: Declares whether LineAmount on this document's lines includes tax: Exclusive (net), Inclusive (gross) or NoTax. Header sub_total/total_tax/total are already normalized regardless — but any SUM over raw line amounts that ignores this flag double-counts tax on Inclusive documents.

dimensions.label: currency code
dimensions.description: ISO 4217 currency of every monetary field on this row and its lines (spec CurrencyCode enum; the extraction truncates the full list, so treat no subset as exhaustive). Summing across currency_code without converting via currency_rate produces a number in no currency at all.

dimensions.label: total tax
dimensions.description: Total tax on the document in document currency. Tax collected is a liability, not revenue — keep it out of income numbers.

dimensions.label: total discount
dimensions.description: Sum of line-level discounts (ACCREC only). Line and header totals are already net of it — subtracting it again undercounts revenue.

dimensions.label: amount paid
dimensions.description: Cash applied to date via payments, in document currency. The row-by-row evidence (with payment status and type) is xero_payments — aggregate collections there, not here.

dimensions.label: amount credited
dimensions.description: Total knocked off this document by credit notes, overpayments and prepayments. Row-level evidence lives in xero_credit_note_allocations and the payments_credits allocation tables.

dimensions.label: fully paid on date
dimensions.description: Date the document reached fully paid; only returned on fully paid invoices. Null does not mean unpaid — check amount_due and status.

dimensions.label: expected payment date
dimensions.description: User-entered cash-forecast date on sales invoices (ACCREC). Frequently absent and never enforced — a planning hint, not a promise.

dimensions.label: planned payment date
dimensions.description: ACCPAY twin of expected_payment_date: when the org plans to pay the bill. Null on sales invoices.

dimensions.label: sent to contact
dimensions.description: Whether the document is marked 'sent' inside Xero (settable only after approval). False does not prove the customer never got it — sending outside Xero bypasses the flag.

dimensions.label: cis deduction
dimensions.description: UK Construction Industry Scheme amount withheld on the document; null outside CIS-enabled UK orgs.

dimensions.label: cis rate
dimensions.description: CIS deduction percentage in force for the org — a rate, never summed.

dimensions.label: is discounted
dimensions.description: True when any line carries a discount; the detail (rate/amount per line) is on xero_invoice_line_items.

dimensions.label: has attachments
dimensions.description: True when files are attached. The files themselves are catalogued in xero_attachments (org_meta) via a rate-limited per-parent fan-out.

dimensions.label: has errors
dimensions.description: True when the payload carried API validation errors — a data-quality signal from write operations, not a business state.

dimensions.label: status attribute string
dimensions.description: Batch-response status indicator that accompanies validation messages (e.g. OK/WARNING/ERROR). Sync diagnostics only; ignore for analytics.

dimensions.label: url
dimensions.description: Link back to the source document in the originating app (shown as 'Go to [appName]' in Xero). Presentation only.

dimensions.label: branding theme id
dimensions.description: Invoice template/branding used; join xero_branding_themes. Orgs often use themes to separate trading lines, so it can act as a de-facto business-unit dimension.

dimensions.label: repeating invoice id
dimensions.description: Template that generated this document when it came from a repeating schedule; null for one-off documents. Join xero_repeating_invoices to measure realized recurring billing.

dimensions.label: updated date utc
dimensions.description: Xero's last-modified audit stamp and the incremental-sync watermark (If-Modified-Since). Never bucket business metrics by it — that is what date is for.

dimensions.label: updated date utc string
dimensions.description: ISO-8601 string twin of updated_date_utc as returned by the API; prefer the parsed timestamp column.

dimensions.label: payments
dimensions.description: Read-only echo of payments applied to this document, kept verbatim for reconciliation. Authoritative payment rows — with their own status and payment_type — live in xero_payments; aggregating this echo double-counts against that table and misses deleted-payment context.

dimensions.label: prepayments
dimensions.description: Read-only echo of prepayments applied to this document. Authoritative rows live in xero_prepayments / xero_prepayment_allocations (payments_credits).

dimensions.label: overpayments
dimensions.description: Read-only echo of overpayments applied to this document. Authoritative rows live in xero_overpayments / xero_overpayment_allocations (payments_credits).

dimensions.label: credit notes
dimensions.description: Read-only echo of credit notes applied to this invoice. The governed rows are xero_credit_notes and the per-application detail is xero_credit_note_allocations — analyze there.

dimensions.label: attachments
dimensions.description: Attachment stubs occasionally echoed on the document payload. The catalogued attachment inventory is xero_attachments (org_meta); this echo is not a complete list.

dimensions.label: validation errors
dimensions.description: API validation error messages carried verbatim ({Message} objects). Data-quality triage only — rows with errors are still real documents.

dimensions.label: warnings
dimensions.description: Non-fatal API warning messages ({Message} objects), the softer counterpart of validation_errors.

dimensions.label: contact
dimensions.description: Invoice.Contact as returned by the pinned OpenAPI. Retained verbatim so the founding canonical mapper keeps reading the column it was written against.

dimensions.label: line items
dimensions.description: See LineItems Retained verbatim so the founding canonical mapper keeps reading the column it was written against.

dimensions.label: item id
dimensions.description: Xero's immutable item identifier and the row key. Document lines do NOT carry it — they reference item_code — so fact joins go through code, not this uuid.

dimensions.label: code
dimensions.description: User-defined item code (max 30 chars) — the de facto foreign key from every invoice, PO and receipt line (item_code). User-editable: a rename silently orphans historical lines, so LEFT JOIN from facts and treat misses as catalog drift.

dimensions.label: name
dimensions.description: Display name (max 50 chars); not unique — code is the identity, name is the label.

dimensions.label: description
dimensions.description: Sales-side description. Xero NULLS this when is_sold flips false — a null on a purchase-only item is expected behavior, not data loss.

dimensions.label: purchase description
dimensions.description: Purchase-side description; nulled by Xero when is_purchased flips false, mirroring the sales side.

dimensions.label: is sold
dimensions.description: Whether the item is offered on sales documents (defaults true). Flipping it false also nulls description and the sales_* defaults — filter on it before reading those columns as configuration gaps.

dimensions.label: is purchased
dimensions.description: Whether the item is available on purchase documents (defaults true); false also nulls purchase_description and the purchase_* defaults.

dimensions.label: is tracked as inventory
dimensions.description: The gate for the whole inventory story: true only when both the inventory asset account and purchase COGS account are configured. Untracked items (services, untracked goods) have NULL quantity_on_hand and total_cost_pool — NULL means 'not tracked', never 'zero stock'.

dimensions.label: inventory asset account code
dimensions.description: GL account (type INVENTORY) holding stock value for tracked items; joins xero_accounts.code. Null on untracked items — its presence is half of what makes an item tracked.

dimensions.label: sales details account code
dimensions.description: Default revenue account applied when the item lands on a sales line; individual lines can override, so revenue-by-account must come from the lines, not this default.

dimensions.label: sales details tax type
dimensions.description: Default sales tax rate key (joins xero_tax_rates.tax_type); the line's tax_type is what actually applied.

dimensions.label: purchase details unit price
dimensions.description: Default purchase price, up to 4dp. Compare with total_cost_pool / quantity_on_hand (true average cost) to spot supplier price drift; never summed.

dimensions.label: purchase details account code
dimensions.description: Default expense account for purchases of UNTRACKED items; per the spec it does not apply to the purchase details of tracked items, where the inventory asset account takes over.

dimensions.label: purchase details cogs account code
dimensions.description: Cost-of-goods-sold account, applicable only to tracked items' purchase details — required (with the inventory asset account) to make an item tracked. Null on untracked items; the sales-side Purchase structure never populates it.

dimensions.label: purchase details tax type
dimensions.description: Default purchase tax rate key (joins xero_tax_rates.tax_type); the transacted rate lives on the document line.

dimensions.label: status attribute string
dimensions.description: Write-response validation indicator from batch upserts; not a catalog lifecycle state (items have none — they hard-delete instead). Ignore for analytics.

dimensions.label: updated date utc
dimensions.description: Server-side modification stamp and the incremental watermark (If-Modified-Since). It moves for any change to the item record, so it timestamps the quantity_on_hand / total_cost_pool snapshot as much as the catalog fields — read it as 'when Xero last touched this row', never as 'when someone edited the catalog'.

dimensions.label: validation errors
dimensions.description: Write-time validation messages retained verbatim for payload fidelity; empty on clean reads, never analytical.

dimensions.label: journal lines journal line id
dimensions.description: The ledger line this tracking pair is stamped on — inherited key from xero_journal_lines.

dimensions.label: journal id
dimensions.description: Denormalized grandparent key so segment aggregates can reach journal_date with one join instead of two.

dimensions.label: journal lines tracking categories
dimensions.description: Zero-based position in the line's TrackingCategories array (0 or 1 — Xero allows at most two pairs per line). Provenance anchor for the exploded container; the meaningful key is (line, category).

dimensions.label: tracking category id
dimensions.description: Which analysis dimension this pair belongs to (e.g. the 'Region' category) — join to xero_tracking_categories. Stable across renames, unlike name.

dimensions.label: tracking option id
dimensions.description: The chosen value within the category (e.g. 'East') — join to xero_tracking_options. Group segments by this id, not by the frozen option text.

dimensions.label: name
dimensions.description: Category name as embedded in the immutable journal at posting time. If the org renames the category later, this diverges from xero_tracking_categories.name — filter by id and use current names for display.

dimensions.label: option
dimensions.description: Option label frozen at posting time; renamed options split history across labels if you group by this string instead of tracking_option_id.

dimensions.label: journal line id
dimensions.description: Xero's immutable identifier for the individual ledger line and the row key.

dimensions.label: journal id
dimensions.description: Parent journal header — inherited key linking the line to its journal_date, source_type and balancing siblings. Every aggregate that needs a date joins through it.

dimensions.label: journal lines
dimensions.description: Zero-based position of this line inside the journal's JournalLines array — the provenance anchor for the exploded container and the statement print order. JournalLineID is the durable key; this preserves how the entry reads on paper.

dimensions.label: account id
dimensions.description: The general ledger account the amount posts to — the join to xero_accounts, whose Class (REVENUE/EXPENSE vs ASSET/LIABILITY/EQUITY) decides whether this line is P&L or balance sheet. Group by this, not by the denormalized name.

dimensions.label: account code
dimensions.description: The account's customer-defined code as at posting time. Codes can be edited on the account later; for stable grouping prefer account_id and take the current code from xero_accounts.

dimensions.label: account type
dimensions.description: The granular posting-time account type. Useful for slicing (BANK, DIRECTCOSTS, OVERHEADS…) but a trap for statements: SALES, REVENUE and OTHERINCOME are all Class REVENUE — filter statements on the account's Class, not on this.

dimensions.label: account name
dimensions.description: Account name frozen at posting time. Renames afterwards live only in xero_accounts, so grouping by this string splits one account's history across labels — display only.

dimensions.label: description
dimensions.description: Narrative carried from the source transaction line; only returned when populated, so expect nulls rather than empty strings.

dimensions.label: tax type
dimensions.description: TaxType code applied to the line — the join key to xero_tax_rates. Null on untaxed lines; codes for deleted/archived rates persist here forever.

dimensions.label: tax name
dimensions.description: Display name of the tax rate as at posting; the current name lives in xero_tax_rates. Join on tax_type, not on this.

dimensions.label: journal id
dimensions.description: Xero's immutable journal identifier and the row key; the join key for xero_journal_lines. JournalNumber is the human-facing sequence, this uuid is the machine one.

dimensions.label: journal date
dimensions.description: The accounting date the entry hits the ledger — the axis for every period total. Back-dated postings make this disagree with created_date_utc by design; bucketing periods on the audit stamp misplaces imports and corrections.

dimensions.label: journal number
dimensions.description: Xero's monotonically increasing journal sequence and the offset-pagination cursor (offset = highest number already ingested, 100 journals per call). Gaps are normal — do not use it as a row count or completeness check.

dimensions.label: created date utc
dimensions.description: When Xero minted the journal record — the If-Modified-Since watermark. Because journals are immutable this is both created and last-modified; a journal seen once never changes.

dimensions.label: reference
dimensions.description: Free-text reference carried over from the source transaction. Useful for display; matching on it is cosmetic — lineage joins go through source_id/source_type.

dimensions.label: source id
dimensions.description: UUID of the originating document — an InvoiceID when source_type is ACCREC/ACCPAY, a ManualJournalID when MANJOURNAL, a BankTransactionID for CASHREC/CASHPAID, and so on. Null for system-generated entries (e.g. conversion balances). Join it per source_type, never blindly to one table.

dimensions.label: source type
dimensions.description: What kind of transaction created this journal — the router for lineage joins and for slicing ledger activity (MANJOURNAL = manual adjustments, PAYSLIP/WAGEPAYABLE/INTEGRATEDPAYROLL* = payroll, TRANSFER = bank transfers, CASHREC/CASHPAID = spend/receive money). ACCREC here means 'journal born from a sales invoice', not the invoice itself.

dimensions.label: journal lines
dimensions.description: See JournalLines Retained verbatim so the founding canonical mapper keeps reading the column it was written against.

dimensions.label: linked transaction id
dimensions.description: Xero's immutable identifier for the billable-expense link and the row key.

dimensions.label: type
dimensions.description: Always BILLABLEEXPENSE today; the spec reserves room for more link kinds. Filtering on it adds nothing yet — but a future value would change this table's meaning, so tolerate unknowns.

dimensions.label: status
dimensions.description: Rebilling pipeline state: APPROVED = recoverable cost not yet on any customer invoice; ONDRAFT = sitting on a draft ACCREC invoice (pipeline, not revenue); BILLED = recharged on an approved invoice; DRAFT mirrors an unapproved source document; VOIDED is dead. 'Unrecovered billable expenses' filters APPROVED.

dimensions.label: source transaction id
dimensions.description: The purchase-side document the cost came from. Polymorphic: an ACCPAY invoice (xero_invoices) when source_transaction_type_code = 'ACCPAY', a spend-money bank transaction (xero_bank_transactions) when 'SPEND'. Branch before joining.

dimensions.label: source line item id
dimensions.description: The exact line on the source document carrying the cost — join xero_invoice_line_items.line_item_id or xero_bank_transaction_line_items.line_item_id depending on the type code. This table has no amounts; the source line is where the cost lives.

dimensions.label: source transaction type code
dimensions.description: Discriminator for every source-side join: ACCPAY = link created from a supplier bill line; SPEND = from a spend-money bank transaction line. Any query that joins the source without branching on this drops or misattributes links.

dimensions.label: target transaction id
dimensions.description: The ACCREC invoice recharging the cost to the customer; null until allocation. Joins xero_invoices — the target is receivable-side by construction.

dimensions.label: target line item id
dimensions.description: The specific line on the target invoice. Multiple billable expenses may share one target line, so target-side revenue rollups must de-duplicate the recharge amount before summing.

dimensions.label: contact id
dimensions.description: The customer the expense is recoverable from, set when the cost is marked billable — present even before any target invoice exists. The axis for 'unbilled recoverables by customer'; joins xero_contacts.

dimensions.label: updated date utc
dimensions.description: Modification stamp on the link record, useful for dating a status transition after the fact. It is not a scan watermark: the list op accepts neither If-Modified-Since nor where, so the ingester full-rescans regardless and this column can never narrow the pull.

dimensions.label: validation errors
dimensions.description: Write-time validation messages retained verbatim for payload fidelity; empty on clean reads and never analytical.

dimensions.label: manual journal id
dimensions.description: The manual journal document these tracking pairs belong to — inherited from the fan-out parent and the first half of the composite positional key. The status filter that decides whether the pair ever reached the statutory ledger lives on this parent (status = 'POSTED'), so segment analysis must join through it, never treat rows here as posted activity on their own.

dimensions.label: line ordinal
dimensions.description: Which document line the pair sits on — positional, like the parent line's own key.

dimensions.label: journal lines tracking
dimensions.description: Zero-based position in the line's Tracking array (0 or 1) — provenance anchor for the exploded container.

dimensions.label: tracking category id
dimensions.description: The analysis dimension being applied — join to xero_tracking_categories.

dimensions.label: tracking option id
dimensions.description: The chosen option within the category — join to xero_tracking_options; the stable segment key.

dimensions.label: name
dimensions.description: Category name as returned on the document; may drift from the dimension table after renames — ids are the truth.

dimensions.label: option
dimensions.description: Option label as returned on the document — display only; group by tracking_option_id.

dimensions.label: manual journal id
dimensions.description: Parent manual journal — inherited key; the status filter that decides whether these lines ever reached the ledger lives on the parent.

dimensions.label: journal lines
dimensions.description: Zero-based position in the document's JournalLines array — the only stable line identity Xero provides (lines carry no uuid) and the provenance anchor for the exploded container.

dimensions.label: account code
dimensions.description: Customer-defined code of the target account as entered; account_id is the durable join — codes can be re-used after edits.

dimensions.label: account id
dimensions.description: The general ledger account the line hits — join to xero_accounts for Class when classifying what an adjustment moved.

dimensions.label: description
dimensions.description: Per-line narrative supplementing the parent's narration.

dimensions.label: tax type
dimensions.description: TaxType code applied to the line — join to xero_tax_rates; drives the calculated tax_amount.

dimensions.label: is blank
dimensions.description: True for empty spacer rows kept in the document layout. They carry no amounts; exclude them from line counts or averages.

dimensions.label: manual journal id
dimensions.description: Xero's identifier for the manual journal document and the row key; xero_journals.source_id points here when source_type = 'MANJOURNAL'.

dimensions.label: narration
dimensions.description: The accountant's required description of why the adjustment exists — the best human signal for classifying corrections vs accruals vs opening balances.

dimensions.label: date
dimensions.description: The accounting date the journal posts to (YYYY-MM-DD) — period bucketing uses this, not updated_date_utc.

dimensions.label: status
dimensions.description: Lifecycle state. Only POSTED affects the ledger; DRAFT and ARCHIVED never posted; DELETED (was draft) and VOIDED (was posted) are dead yet still returned. Every total over lines must filter status = 'POSTED' or drafts and voids contaminate it.

dimensions.label: line amount types
dimensions.description: Whether line amounts are tax Exclusive, Inclusive, or NoTax. With Inclusive, a line's LineAmount contains its TaxAmount — summing LineAmount across mixed documents double-counts tax; the statutory net lives in xero_journal_lines.

dimensions.label: url
dimensions.description: Link back to a source document in an external app (shown as 'Go to [appName]' in Xero) — presence signals the journal was machine-created by an integration.

dimensions.label: show on cash basis reports
dimensions.description: Whether the journal participates in cash-basis reporting (defaults true). Irrelevant to accrual questions; only matters when replicating Xero's cash-basis statements.

dimensions.label: has attachments
dimensions.description: True when supporting documents are attached — the cheap pre-filter before fanning out to org_meta's per-parent attachments endpoint with its 60/min rate budget.

dimensions.label: updated date utc
dimensions.description: Last-modified audit stamp and the incremental sync watermark (If-Modified-Since). Not the accounting date — see date.

dimensions.label: status attribute string
dimensions.description: Write-response marker (e.g. ERROR/WARNING) accompanying validation payloads; carries no accounting meaning on read and is null in normal scans.

dimensions.label: warnings
dimensions.description: Verbatim array of API warning messages — populated on write responses, effectively always null in read scans. Kept for payload fidelity; element shape is the spec's ValidationError (Message), not owned by this domain.

dimensions.label: validation errors
dimensions.description: Verbatim array of API validation errors — write-time noise, null in read scans; presentation-only.

dimensions.label: attachments
dimensions.description: Verbatim attachment stubs occasionally embedded in responses. The governed copy of attachment metadata is org_meta's xero_attachments — query that, treat this as raw evidence.

dimensions.label: journal lines
dimensions.description: See JournalLines Retained verbatim so the founding canonical mapper keeps reading the column it was written against.

dimensions.label: invoice id
dimensions.description: The sales invoice this sharing URL belongs to (inherited fan-out key); join xero_invoices.

dimensions.label: online invoice url
dimensions.description: Publicly reachable URL of the hosted invoice. Anyone with the link can view the document — treat as shareable-sensitive even though it is not personal data per se.

dimensions.label: organisation id
dimensions.description: The organisation these entitlements belong to — the connection's single org, inherited as row context (the Action payload itself carries no org id).

dimensions.label: name
dimensions.description: Entitlement name, e.g. 'UseMulticurrency', 'Payroll', 'AttachFiles'. Open vocabulary — Xero adds names without notice, so treat values as data and never hard-code an exhaustive list.

dimensions.label: status
dimensions.description: Whether the org's plan/region grants the capability. Note the hyphen: the negative value is NOT-ALLOWED, not NOT_ALLOWED — an underscore filter silently matches nothing and makes every feature look enabled.

dimensions.label: organisation id
