measures.label: discount amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Total value of sale discounts given on this day at this shop (the docs call it the subtotal of sale discounts). The docs do not state the SIGN convention, so whether it must be added to or subtracted from a subtotal is unverified - check one known day against a raw sale before wiring it into a net-revenue formula. Also unstated: whether manual price overrides at the register count as discounts here, or only named discount rules. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one shop per day

measures.label: report tax class sales by day rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one tax class per shop per day. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one tax class per shop per day

measures.label: subtotal
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Sales subtotal for this class on this day at this shop, EX TAX. Comparing it directly to tax-inclusive sale totals from a tax-inclusive category understates by the whole rate, which reads as a plausible shortfall rather than an error. This is the revenue side of every margin calculation in this table. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one tax class per shop per day

measures.label: fifo cost
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Cost of goods sold in this group valued First In First Out - an EXTENDED total for the group, not a unit cost. subtotal - fifo_cost is what Lightspeed's own profit reporting shows. It is one of TWO alternative bases in this row; adding it to avg_cost double-counts COGS and halves reported margin. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one tax class per shop per day

measures.label: avg cost
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Cost of the same goods valued at weighted-average cost - the ALTERNATIVE basis to fifo_cost for the identical sales, not an additional cost. Its name reads like a per-unit average, which is the trap: treating it as a unit figure and multiplying by quantity, or summing it alongside fifo_cost, both produce plausible wrong margins. Pick one basis and hold it across every period being compared. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one tax class per shop per day

measures.label: report orders by tax class rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one tax-class cost subtotal within one received purchase order. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one tax-class cost subtotal within one received purchase order

measures.label: cost
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Subtotal COST (what you paid the vendor) for items of this tax class on this order - not retail value, not landed cost. This is the one genuinely additive measure on the table: it may be summed across rows, orders, vendors and days. It excludes freight and other charges, which live in the two order-level columns. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one tax-class cost subtotal within one received purchase order

measures.label: total ship cost
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The ENTIRE order's shipping cost, repeated verbatim on every tax-class row of that order - the docs say explicitly not to sum it. SUM(total_ship_cost) over a multi-class order multiplies freight by the number of classes, producing an inflated but entirely plausible spend figure. Take MAX() per order_id, or aggregate to order level first. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one tax-class cost subtotal within one received purchase order

measures.label: total other cost
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The ENTIRE order's other/ancillary charges, repeated on every tax-class row exactly like total_ship_cost, with the same explicit do-not-sum warning in the docs. Same mitigation: MAX() per order_id or a per-order subquery before rolling up. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one tax-class cost subtotal within one received purchase order

measures.label: 1099 contacts rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one 1099 summary row per contact per report tax year. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one 1099 summary row per contact per report tax year

measures.label: box1
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Amount reported in box 1 of the contact's 1099 for the year. Box-to-meaning mapping follows the IRS form revision Xero applied for that year (MISC vs NEC changed in 2020) — the API does not label boxes semantically, so never hardcode a meaning across years. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one 1099 summary row per contact per report tax year

measures.label: box7
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Amount in box 7 for the year. On pre-2020 1099-MISC this was nonemployee compensation — the headline number — before it moved to 1099-NEC box 1; check the year before calling it contractor pay. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one 1099 summary row per contact per report tax year

measures.label: 1099 reports rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one 1099 report header per requested tax year. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one 1099 report header per requested tax year

measures.label: accounts rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one chart-of-accounts entry per AccountID. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one chart-of-accounts entry per AccountID

measures.label: asset settings rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one fixed-asset settings record per organisation (unkeyed API singleton). This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one fixed-asset settings record per organisation (unkeyed API singleton)

measures.label: asset types rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one asset type (depreciation class) per assetTypeId. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one asset type (depreciation class) per assetTypeId

measures.label: assets rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one fixed-asset register entry per assetId (Draft, Registered or Disposed). This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one fixed-asset register entry per assetId (Draft, Registered or Disposed)

measures.label: purchase price
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Historical acquisition cost in the organisation's base currency (the Assets API is base-currency only). This is capex at purchase, never current worth — current worth is accounting_book_value. When cost_limit is set below it, only cost_limit depreciates. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one fixed-asset register entry per assetId (Draft, Registered or Disposed)

measures.label: disposal price
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Sale proceeds at disposal (0 for scrapped assets), base currency. The outcome is decomposed separately into current_capital_gain (proceeds above original cost) and current_gain_loss (vs remaining book value) — adding disposal_price to either double-counts the proceeds. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one fixed-asset register entry per assetId (Draft, Registered or Disposed)

measures.label: book depreciation setting depreciation rate
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Annual depreciation rate as a decimal fraction (0.05 = 5% per year), operative only when depreciation_calculation_method = 'Rate'. A ratio: never summed, never a currency amount. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one fixed-asset register entry per assetId (Draft, Registered or Disposed)

measures.label: book depreciation detail cost limit
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Optional cap on the depreciable base: when set below purchase_price, Xero depreciates only this amount and the remainder never expenses. Null means the full cost depreciates. Future-depreciation projections that ignore it overstate expense. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one fixed-asset register entry per assetId (Draft, Registered or Disposed)

measures.label: book depreciation detail residual value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Salvage floor depreciation stops at. Fully-depreciated assets with a residual still show a nonzero accounting_book_value — 'book value = 0' is the wrong test for fully depreciated. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one fixed-asset register entry per assetId (Draft, Registered or Disposed)

measures.label: book depreciation detail prior accum depreciation amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Depreciation accumulated in financial years BEFORE the current one, including any opening balance migrated into Xero. Lifetime accumulated depreciation = this + current_accum_depreciation_amount; either alone understates. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one fixed-asset register entry per assetId (Draft, Registered or Disposed)

measures.label: book depreciation detail current accum depreciation amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Depreciation booked in the CURRENT financial year only, through the last depreciation run — effectively depreciation expense YTD for the asset, and it resets to zero at financial year end. Not lifetime accumulation; add prior_accum_depreciation_amount for that. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one fixed-asset register entry per assetId (Draft, Registered or Disposed)

measures.label: book depreciation detail current capital gain
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of On disposal: sell price minus original purchase price when sold at a profit over cost — the capital-gain slice, posted to the capital-gain disposal account. Zero or null for undisposed assets and loss-making disposals. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one fixed-asset register entry per assetId (Draft, Registered or Disposed)

measures.label: book depreciation detail current gain loss
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of On disposal: the lower of sell price or purchase price, minus book value at disposal — the ordinary gain/loss-on-disposal slice that hits P&L. current_capital_gain and current_gain_loss together decompose the proceeds-vs-book outcome; summing either with disposal_price double-counts. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one fixed-asset register entry per assetId (Draft, Registered or Disposed)

measures.label: accounting book value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Current net book value on the ACCOUNTING book: depreciable cost less accumulated depreciation, computed through the last depreciation run — THE answer to 'what are our assets worth on the books'. Last-value-over-time: only the latest row per asset counts, and totals filter asset_status = 'Registered' (Draft is unposted, Disposed is frozen history). This spec revision exposes no tax-book counterpart (no taxValues object), so book value here is accounting basis only. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one fixed-asset register entry per assetId (Draft, Registered or Disposed)

measures.label: attachments rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one attachment on one parent record, keyed by parent endpoint + parent id + attachment id. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one attachment on one parent record, keyed by parent endpoint + parent id + attachment id

measures.label: bank transaction line item tracking rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one tracking category/option assignment on one bank transaction line item. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one tracking category/option assignment on one bank transaction line item

measures.label: bank transaction line items rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one GL coding line per bank transaction, keyed by its zero-based position in the LineItems array. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one GL coding line per bank transaction, keyed by its zero-based position in the LineItems array

measures.label: tax amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Tax on this line in the parent's currency (auto-calculated unless overridden). With Inclusive line_amount_types it sits INSIDE line_amount; with Exclusive it is on top — the deflation term for ex-tax analysis. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one GL coding line per bank transaction, keyed by its zero-based position in the LineItems array

measures.label: line amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The line's value in the parent's currency, and a chameleon: it excludes tax when the parent is Exclusive but INCLUDES it when Inclusive. Ex-tax spend = line_amount - CASE WHEN parent Inclusive THEN tax_amount ELSE 0 END. Unsigned — direction comes from the parent's type. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one GL coding line per bank transaction, keyed by its zero-based position in the LineItems array

measures.label: bank transactions rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one money-in or money-out movement on one Xero bank account per BankTransactionID. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one money-in or money-out movement on one Xero bank account per BankTransactionID

measures.label: currency rate
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Exchange rate to the organisation's base currency at the transaction date; populated for non-base-currency bank accounts (user-defined or XE.com day rate otherwise). Base-currency reporting multiplies monetary fields by this, COALESCEd to 1 for base-currency rows. A rate, never summable. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one money-in or money-out movement on one Xero bank account per BankTransactionID

measures.label: sub total
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Transaction total excluding tax, in currency_code, normalized by Xero regardless of line_amount_types — the safe ex-tax measure when you do not need line detail. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one money-in or money-out movement on one Xero bank account per BankTransactionID

measures.label: total tax
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Tax on the whole transaction in currency_code; sub_total + total_tax = total. The header-level tax truth even when Inclusive lines bury tax inside line_amount. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one money-in or money-out movement on one Xero bank account per BankTransactionID

measures.label: total
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Tax-inclusive value of the movement in currency_code, always positive — direction lives in type, not the sign. Net cash flow requires CASE on type before summing; raw SUM(total) over mixed types is meaningless. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one money-in or money-out movement on one Xero bank account per BankTransactionID

measures.label: bank transfers rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one instruction moving funds between two bank accounts of the same organisation per BankTransferID. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one instruction moving funds between two bank accounts of the same organisation per BankTransferID

measures.label: amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The transferred amount as entered on the instruction. Internal movement, NEVER income or expense — excluding this money from cash in/out is the whole point of this table. For cross-currency transfers, each account's local-currency truth is its leg's total in xero_bank_transactions. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one instruction moving funds between two bank accounts of the same organisation per BankTransferID

measures.label: currency rate
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Read-only rate Xero recorded for cross-currency transfers; null/1 for same-currency moves. A rate, never summable — convert before aggregating mixed-currency transfer volumes. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one instruction moving funds between two bank accounts of the same organisation per BankTransferID

measures.label: batch payments rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one batch payment header per BatchPaymentID, grouping member payments into a single bank movement. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one batch payment header per BatchPaymentID, grouping member payments into a single bank movement

measures.label: total amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Read-only sum of the member payments, computed by Xero. Equals SUM(xero_payments.amount) over AUTHORISED members with this batch_payment_id; any metric that adds both this and the member rows has double-counted the cash. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one batch payment header per BatchPaymentID, grouping member payments into a single bank movement

measures.label: branding themes rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one branding theme per BrandingThemeID. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one branding theme per BrandingThemeID

measures.label: budget balances rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one budgeted period amount per (budget, account, period). This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one budgeted period amount per (budget, account, period)

measures.label: amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The budgeted value for the period — empirically the monetary figure, despite the spec's miscopied 'LineItem Quantity' description. Budget amounts are positive for both revenue and expense plans; flip the sign of REVENUE-class actuals (or ABS them) before computing variance. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one budgeted period amount per (budget, account, period)

measures.label: budget lines rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one budgeted account per (budget, account). This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one budgeted account per (budget, account)

measures.label: budget tracking rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one tracking category/option pair scoping a budget per (budget, tracking category). This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.

measures.label: contact balances rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one current AR/AP balance snapshot per contact, as of the latest sync. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one current AR/AP balance snapshot per contact, as of the latest sync

measures.label: accounts receivable outstanding
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of What the contact currently owes you across unpaid sales invoices — in RAW document currencies, unconverted to base. For a contact invoiced in several currencies this is a sum across currencies and therefore not a real number; reconcile against open ACCREC invoices in xero_invoices when precision matters. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one current AR/AP balance snapshot per contact, as of the latest sync

measures.label: accounts receivable overdue
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The past-due PORTION of accounts_receivable_outstanding — a subset, not an increment. Adding outstanding and overdue double-counts every late invoice; 'not yet due' is outstanding minus overdue. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one current AR/AP balance snapshot per contact, as of the latest sync

measures.label: accounts payable outstanding
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of What you currently owe the contact across unpaid bills, in raw document currencies. The supplier-side mirror of AR outstanding, with the identical multi-currency trap. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one current AR/AP balance snapshot per contact, as of the latest sync

measures.label: accounts payable overdue
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The past-due portion of accounts_payable_outstanding — again a subset. This is the 'we are paying suppliers late' signal, not an addition to the amount owed. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one current AR/AP balance snapshot per contact, as of the latest sync

measures.label: contact cis settings rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one CIS deduction profile per contact (UK Construction Industry Scheme orgs only). This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one CIS deduction profile per contact (UK Construction Industry Scheme orgs only)

measures.label: rate
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of CIS deduction percentage withheld from the subcontractor's payments (read-only; Xero omits it entirely when cis_enabled is false, so null on a disabled row is normal). A RATE — apply it, never sum or average it across contacts. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one CIS deduction profile per contact (UK Construction Industry Scheme orgs only)

measures.label: contact group members rows

measures.label: contacts rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one Xero contact record per ContactID, including ACTIVE, ARCHIVED, GDPRREQUEST and merged-away records. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.

measures.label: credit note allocations rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one allocation of one credit note against one invoice, per credit note and array position. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.

measures.label: allocations amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Amount of credit applied to that invoice, positive, in the CREDIT NOTE's currency. SUM(amount) per credit note reconciles to the parent's applied_amount; per invoice it explains part of amount_credited. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one allocation of one credit note against one invoice, per credit note and array position

measures.label: credit note line items rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one line item on one credit note per LineItemID. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one line item on one credit note per LineItemID

measures.label: line items line amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Credited value of the line, stored positive, in document currency. Includes tax only when the PARENT's line_amount_types is Inclusive. Net revenue by product = invoiced line_amount minus credited line_amount, both tax-normalized the same way. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one line item on one credit note per LineItemID

measures.label: credit notes rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one credit note document (customer credit ACCRECCREDIT or supplier credit ACCPAYCREDIT) per CreditNoteID. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one credit note document (customer credit ACCRECCREDIT or supplier credit ACCPAYCREDIT) per CreditNoteID

measures.label: currency rate
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Rate to the org's base currency fixed for this document (XE.com day rate unless overridden); multiply monetary fields by it for base-currency reporting. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one credit note document (customer credit ACCRECCREDIT or supplier credit ACCPAYCREDIT) per CreditNoteID

measures.label: sub total
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Tax-exclusive credit value in document currency. Stored positive — it REDUCES revenue/spend, so netting requires subtraction (or negate when unioning with invoice lines). The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one credit note document (customer credit ACCRECCREDIT or supplier credit ACCPAYCREDIT) per CreditNoteID

measures.label: total
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Tax-inclusive credit value (sub_total + total_tax), stored positive in document currency. The full face value — not what has been used; see applied_amount and remaining_credit. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one credit note document (customer credit ACCRECCREDIT or supplier credit ACCPAYCREDIT) per CreditNoteID

measures.label: remaining credit
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Unconsumed credit balance right now (face value minus allocations and refunds). Current-state, not historical. Outstanding customer credit liability = SUM(remaining_credit) WHERE type='ACCRECCREDIT' AND status='AUTHORISED'. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one credit note document (customer credit ACCRECCREDIT or supplier credit ACCPAYCREDIT) per CreditNoteID

measures.label: currencies rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one currency per ISO code enabled in the org's subscription. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one currency per ISO code enabled in the org's subscription

measures.label: expense claim payments rows

measures.grain: one reimbursement payment applied to one expense claim

measures.label: amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Reimbursement amount in org base currency. Part-payments are legal: SUM per claim to compare against the claim's total. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one reimbursement payment applied to one expense claim

measures.label: expense claim receipts rows

measures.label: total
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Claim value being reimbursed, in org base currency. Reconciles to the sum of its receipts' totals via xero_expense_claim_receipts — differences flag voided or declined receipts. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one expense claim submitted by one org user for reimbursement

measures.label: amount due
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Outstanding reimbursement liability as at the last sync, not as at any date you choose. Xero overwrites it in place with no history, so 'what did we owe employees at 30 June' cannot be answered from this column — rebuild that from claim totals minus xero_expense_claim_payments dated on or before the cut-off. Live liability also requires excluding VOIDED/DELETED claims, whose amounts linger in the payload. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one expense claim submitted by one org user for reimbursement

measures.label: amount paid
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Cumulative amount already reimbursed, so that amount_paid + amount_due reconciles to total. Note the spec's own doc string for this field reads 'the amount still to pay' — the identical sentence it gives AmountDue — which is a copy-paste defect in the published OpenAPI, not two fields meaning the same thing; the field name and the arithmetic are the reliable guide. Like amount_due it is overwritten each sync and carries no history. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one expense claim submitted by one org user for reimbursement

measures.label: file associations rows

measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Xero's count of files sitting in the folder at the moment of the folder sweep. It drifts from reality between syncs — the authoritative live number is COUNT(*) of xero_files per folder_id — and persistent disagreement is a sync-freshness signal, not a data bug. Never sum it across historical snapshots. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one row per folder in the tenant's Xero Files library, including the system Inbox

measures.label: history records rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one audit/history event per parent record per array position at sync time. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.

measures.label: invoice line items rows

measures.label: line items unit amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Per-unit price in the document's currency BEFORE any discount. A rate: never sum it — billed value is line_amount. Average selling price should be SUM(line_amount)/SUM(quantity), not AVG(unit_amount). The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.

measures.label: line items line amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The line's billed value in document currency, already net of DiscountRate/DiscountAmount. measures.label: line items tax amount

measures.label: currency rate
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Exchange rate to the organisation's base currency fixed for this document (XE.com day rate unless overridden). Base-currency reporting multiplies monetary fields by this rate; the rate itself is never summed or averaged. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one invoice document (sales invoice ACCREC or bill ACCPAY) per InvoiceID

measures.label: sub total
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Tax-exclusive document total in document currency, normalized by Xero regardless of line_amount_types — the safest header-grain revenue/spend measure. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one invoice document (sales invoice ACCREC or bill ACCPAY) per InvoiceID

measures.label: total
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Tax-inclusive total (sub_total + total_tax) in document currency. This is billed value, not cash received — settlement lives in amount_paid/amount_due and xero_payments. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one invoice document (sales invoice ACCREC or bill ACCPAY) per InvoiceID

measures.label: amount due
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Open balance right now in document currency (total minus payments and credits). Current-state: yesterday's AR cannot be reconstructed from it. AR today = SUM(amount_due) WHERE type='ACCREC' AND status='AUTHORISED'. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one invoice document (sales invoice ACCREC or bill ACCPAY) per InvoiceID

measures.label: items rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one product or service item in the org's catalog, identified by ItemID. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one product or service item in the org's catalog, identified by ItemID

measures.label: sales details unit price
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Default (list) selling price offered in the UI, up to 4dp. The transacted price is unit_amount on the document line — computing revenue from this column is fiction. A rate: never summed. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one product or service item in the org's catalog, identified by ItemID

measures.label: quantity on hand
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Units in stock as of the LAST SYNC — a point-in-time snapshot with no history; NULL (not zero) for untracked items. Period-over-period stock movement cannot be derived from this table, and yesterday's value is gone once resynced. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one product or service item in the org's catalog, identified by ItemID

measures.label: total cost pool
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Value of stock on hand under Xero's average-cost method, as of the last sync; NULL for untracked items. Inventory valuation = SUM over tracked items; total_cost_pool / NULLIF(quantity_on_hand, 0) is the average unit cost. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one product or service item in the org's catalog, identified by ItemID

measures.label: journal line tracking rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one tracking category/option pair applied to one journal line (at most two pairs per line). This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one tracking category/option pair applied to one journal line (at most two pairs per line)

measures.label: journal lines rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one signed debit or credit ledger line per JournalLineID (a globally unique uuid). This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one signed debit or credit ledger line per JournalLineID (a globally unique uuid)

measures.label: net amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The signed base-currency movement: positive for a debit, negative for a credit; sums to zero per journal. Revenue therefore aggregates NEGATIVE — present P&L income as -SUM(net_amount) or profit reads as loss. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one signed debit or credit ledger line per JournalLineID (a globally unique uuid)

measures.label: gross amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of NetAmount + TaxAmount. Summing this for spend or revenue double-counts GST/VAT, which also posts to its own tax-control account lines — statements use net_amount. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one signed debit or credit ledger line per JournalLineID (a globally unique uuid)

measures.label: tax amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Read-only tax portion on this line in base currency. Tax-liability questions belong to the tax-control accounts (SystemAccount GST) — summing this column mixes rate applications with the control postings. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one signed debit or credit ledger line per JournalLineID (a globally unique uuid)

measures.label: journals rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one immutable statutory journal header per posted transaction event (JournalID). This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one immutable statutory journal header per posted transaction event (JournalID)

measures.label: linked transactions rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one billable-expense link from one source purchase line to (at most) one target sales invoice line. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.

measures.label: manual journal line tracking rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one tracking category/option pair per (manual journal, line position, tracking category). This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one tracking category/option pair per (manual journal, line position, tracking category)

measures.label: manual journal lines rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one entry line per (manual journal, zero-based array position). This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one entry line per (manual journal, zero-based array position)

measures.label: line amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Signed document amount: debits positive, credits negative; a balanced journal sums to zero (net of tax handling). Under LineAmountTypes = Inclusive this CONTAINS tax_amount — normalize before comparing across documents; the statutory net is xero_journal_lines.net_amount. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.

measures.label: tax amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Tax calculated from tax_type and line_amount. Whether it is inside or on top of line_amount depends on the parent's LineAmountTypes — check before netting. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one entry line per (manual journal, zero-based array position)

measures.label: manual journals rows

measures.grain: one manual journal document per ManualJournalID

measures.label: online invoices rows

measures.label: organisation cis settings rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one CIS configuration record per organisation. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.

measures.label: rate
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of CIS deduction percentage as a whole-number percent (20 means 20%), read-only and set by HMRC verification status (30 unverified, 20 standard, 0 gross-payment). measures.label: organisation external links rows

measures.label: organisation payment terms rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one default payment-term rule per organisation per document side (SALES or BILLS). This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one default payment-term rule per organisation per document side (SALES or BILLS)

measures.label: bills day
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Numeric day whose meaning flips with term_type: for DAYSAFTERBILLDATE/DAYSAFTERBILLMONTH it is a day COUNT (net-N), for OFCURRENTMONTH/OFFOLLOWINGMONTH it is a calendar day-of-month (the Nth). 20 can mean 'net 20' or 'the 20th' — never read it without term_type. Projection reads PaymentTerm.Bills.Day for the BILLS row and the identically-shaped PaymentTerm.Sales.Day for the SALES row (term_scope selects the branch). The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one default payment-term rule per organisation per document side (SALES or BILLS)

measures.label: organisation phones rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one phone entry per organisation per phone type slot. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one phone entry per organisation per phone type slot

measures.label: organisations rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one organisation profile per connected Xero tenant. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one organisation profile per connected Xero tenant

measures.label: financial year end day
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Day component of fiscal year end (calendar day 0-31). 'This financial year' in any P&L-style question means the year ending on this day/month, not the calendar year — defaulting to Jan-Dec silently misstates YTD for most AU/NZ/UK orgs. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one organisation profile per connected Xero tenant

measures.label: financial year end month
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Month component of fiscal year end (1-12). Pair with financial_year_end_day to derive fiscal periods; AU orgs typically end 30/6, UK 31/3 — never assume December. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one organisation profile per connected Xero tenant

measures.label: overpayment allocations rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one application of overpayment credit to one invoice, keyed by parent overpayment and array position. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one application of overpayment credit to one invoice, keyed by parent overpayment and array position

measures.label: amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Credit applied to the invoice, in the DOCUMENT currency, up to 4dp. Settlement only — the cash event was the original excess payment. Reduces the invoice's AmountDue and the parent's remaining_credit equally. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one application of overpayment credit to one invoice, keyed by parent overpayment and array position

measures.label: overpayments rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one overpayment credit document per OverpaymentID. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one overpayment credit document per OverpaymentID

measures.label: sub total
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Tax-exclusive total of the overpayment in currency_code — always ex-tax regardless of line_amount_types. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one overpayment credit document per OverpaymentID

measures.label: total
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of sub_total + total_tax in currency_code: the full size of the credit when created; never changes as credit is consumed. Lifecycle position comes from applied_amount and remaining_credit. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one overpayment credit document per OverpaymentID

measures.label: currency rate
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Rate to the org's base currency at creation; the XE.com day rate when none was specified. Multiply monetary columns by this for base-currency reporting; null means base currency (treat as 1.0). Never SUM a rate. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one overpayment credit document per OverpaymentID

measures.label: remaining credit
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Unapplied credit RIGHT NOW — a balance restated on every sync, not history. SUM across AUTHORISED rows gives today's outstanding overpayment credit; do not trend it over time from this table, and do not expect total - applied_amount to equal it once cash refunds exist. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one overpayment credit document per OverpaymentID

measures.label: payment services rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one custom online-payment service configuration per PaymentServiceID. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.

measures.label: payments rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one payment or refund applied against exactly one invoice, credit note, prepayment or overpayment. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one payment or refund applied against exactly one invoice, credit note, prepayment or overpayment

measures.label: amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The applied amount in the DOCUMENT's currency, up to 4dp. For foreign-currency invoices this is not what left the bank — see bank_amount for the bank-side figure and currency_rate for the conversion actually used. Summing amount across currencies without converting is a number in no currency. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payment or refund applied against exactly one invoice, credit note, prepayment or overpayment

measures.label: bank amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of What actually moved through the bank account, in the BANK account's currency. Equals amount only when document and bank currencies match. Cash-in-bank questions read bank_amount; document-settlement questions read amount — mixing the two misstates FX differences. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payment or refund applied against exactly one invoice, credit note, prepayment or overpayment

measures.label: currency rate
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Exchange rate captured when the payment was received; populated only for payments against non-base-currency invoices and credit notes. Multiply amount by this to restate in the org's base currency; null means the document is already base currency — treat as 1.0, never drop the row. A rate, so never SUM it. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payment or refund applied against exactly one invoice, credit note, prepayment or overpayment

A standing instruction, not a payment: summing it gives neither net pay nor cash out, because the remainder split's variable share is not represented here. measures.label: payroll au employee leave balances rows

measures.label: number of units
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The leave available right now, in the leave type's units. Negative values are legitimate (leave taken in advance). This is the number leave-liability estimates start from — multiplied by the employee's rate, and only for leave types that pay out. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.

measures.label: payroll au employee super memberships rows

measures.label: payroll au pay runs rows

measures.label: wages
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Total gross wages for the run — the sum of its payslips' Wages, which already includes ordinary, leave and timesheet earnings. Do not add payslip or earnings-line sums on top of this; pick one grain. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one pay run, keyed by PayRunID — one processing of one payroll calendar over one pay period

measures.label: deductions
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Total employee deductions withheld in the run, stored as a positive magnitude that is subtracted from gross on the way to net pay. It is money withheld from employees, not an extra employer cost. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one pay run, keyed by PayRunID — one processing of one payroll calendar over one pay period

measures.label: tax
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Total PAYG withholding for the run, a positive magnitude withheld from employees and owed to the ATO. It is part of gross wages, not a cost on top of them. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one pay run, keyed by PayRunID — one processing of one payroll calendar over one pay period

measures.label: super
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Total superannuation for the run across all contribution types. Employer-funded SGC is a cost ON TOP of wages, but this total also folds in salary-sacrifice and employee contributions that came out of gross — for a clean employer-cost split use xero_payroll_au_payslip_superannuation_lines filtered by contribution_type. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one pay run, keyed by PayRunID — one processing of one payroll calendar over one pay period

measures.label: net pay
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of What actually lands in employees' bank accounts: wages minus deductions, PAYG tax and employee-funded super (salary-sacrifice and member contributions, which sit on the superannuation lines rather than in Deductions), plus reimbursements. It is NOT the employer's payroll cost (that is wages plus employer super) — mixing the two understates cost by the withholdings. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one pay run, keyed by PayRunID — one processing of one payroll calendar over one pay period

measures.label: payroll au pay template deduction lines rows

measures.label: payroll au payroll calendars rows

measures.label: amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Employer contribution on this line in NZD — the additive measure of the table. A cost outside the employee's pay: never subtract it from gross when computing take-home. Whether this figure is stated gross of ESCT (with the tax levied out of it) or net of ESCT is NOT settled by the spec, and it decides whether employer tax lines add to this or are already inside it — establish which for the tenant by reconciling super + employer tax against the run's total_cost before reporting a super cost. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one superannuation line on one payslip (position within PaySlip.superannuationLines)

measures.label: number of units
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Timesheet units paid, ordinarily hours — the closest thing this domain has to 'hours worked' for hourly staff (the source Timesheet objects are not exposed in this domain's operations). The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one timesheet-sourced earnings line on one payslip (position within PaySlip.timesheetEarningsLines)

measures.label: amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Timesheet pay for this line in NZD — the additive measure, already inside the payslip's gross_earnings. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one timesheet-sourced earnings line on one payslip (position within PaySlip.timesheetEarningsLines)

measures.label: payroll nz payslips rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one payslip — one employee's pay within one pay run. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip — one employee's pay within one pay run

measures.label: total earnings
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Earnings before any deductions. Per the spec this is IDENTICAL to gross_earnings for NZ — the schema is shared with other regions where they differ. Pick one (this dictionary standardises on gross_earnings) and never sum both, which exactly doubles gross pay. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip — one employee's pay within one pay run

measures.label: gross earnings
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Gross pay for the period: the sum of the ordinary, leave and timesheet earnings line families combined. Summing only xero_payroll_nz_payslip_earnings_lines understates gross for anyone paid via timesheets or on leave — the three families partition gross, they don't overlap. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip — one employee's pay within one pay run

measures.label: total pay
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The employee's NET pay — cash to their bank accounts, equal to the sum of this payslip's payment lines. Reconciles as gross_earnings − total_employee_taxes − total_deductions − total_statutory_deductions + total_reimbursements. Presenting this as salary or cost is the domain's most common wrong number. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip — one employee's pay within one pay run

measures.label: total employer taxes
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Employer-side tax for this payslip (in NZ practice, ESCT on employer superannuation contributions). A cost ON TOP of gross — never subtract it when computing take-home, and never add it to total_employee_taxes as 'tax paid by the employee'. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip — one employee's pay within one pay run

measures.label: total employee taxes
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Tax withheld from the employee's earnings (PAYE). Deducted from gross on the way to net. 'Total PAYE remitted' questions sum this over Posted runs bucketed by the run's payment_date, which fixes the IRD filing period. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip — one employee's pay within one pay run

measures.label: total deductions
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Voluntary/contractual deductions (the deductionLines family): social club, payroll giving, employee super top-ups and the like. Modelled as EXCLUDING statutory withholdings (student loan, child support, employee KiwiSaver), which are total_statutory_deductions — the spec's wording here ('total amount subtracted to reach total pay') is loose, so confirm the split reconciles before reporting a combined deductions figure. Adding a line-family sum on top of this header double-counts either way. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip — one employee's pay within one pay run

measures.label: total reimbursements
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Non-taxable repayments of out-of-pocket expenses, ADDED to pay after tax. Not earnings: include them in 'cash paid to employees' but exclude them from wage-cost and average-earnings analysis or both go high. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip — one employee's pay within one pay run

measures.label: total statutory deductions
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Withholdings required by law (statutoryDeductionLines family): student loan, child support, employee KiwiSaver contributions. Modelled as disjoint from total_deductions, so 'all deductions' is the sum of both — but prove the disjointness on a sample payslip first: the spec describes totalDeductions as the total subtracted to reach total pay, and if a tenant populates it that way, adding these columns double-counts every statutory dollar. The line families are the tiebreak. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip — one employee's pay within one pay run

measures.label: total superannuation
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Employer superannuation contributions (KiwiSaver employer side; the spec's 'benefits' wording is generic schema text). An employer cost outside the employee's pay, not money withheld from them — the employee's own KiwiSaver contribution lives in the statutory deduction lines, and confusing the two moves real money between 'what staff gave up' and 'what we spent'. Do not reflexively add total_employer_taxes to this to get super cost: in NZ, ESCT is levied on the employer contribution and may already be netted inside this figure. Reconcile any employer-cost build-up against xero_payroll_nz_pay_runs.total_cost, which is Xero's own answer. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip — one employee's pay within one pay run

measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of SAP already received this fiscal year before Xero took over. Zero means either none or the org migrated at fiscal year start — check the org's first pay run before concluding 'no adoption pay'. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.

measures.label: statutory maternity pay
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of SMP already received this fiscal year pre-migration; add to payslip SMP for a true fiscal-YTD figure and for testing against the 39-week entitlement. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.

measures.label: statutory paternity pay
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of SPP already received this fiscal year before Xero took over payroll. Ordinary statutory paternity pay runs to a small fixed number of weeks, so a non-zero opening here can mean the entitlement is already spent and no further SPP is due in this employment — a payslip-only view would show none paid and wrongly conclude the leave never happened. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one migration-time opening balance record per employee

measures.label: statutory shared parental pay
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Shared parental pay already received this fiscal year before Xero took over payroll. ShPP is carved out of the mother's or primary adopter's maternity/adoption entitlement, so this figure and statutory_maternity_pay/statutory_adoption_pay are competing draws on one pot rather than independent amounts — add them for a fiscal-YTD statutory total, but never read them as separate entitlements when testing remaining weeks. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one migration-time opening balance record per employee

measures.label: statutory sick pay
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of SSP already received this fiscal year pre-migration; without it, weeks-of-SSP-remaining computed from Xero payslips alone overstates remaining entitlement. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one migration-time opening balance record per employee

measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Contracted units (hours) per week. measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Hourly rate for Hourly payment types; derived for salaried staff. The number to test against National Minimum/Living Wage floors — annual_salary is not. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.

measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Entitlement remaining as of the scan's AsOfDate, in Hours. Converting to statutory weeks requires the employee's working pattern — dividing by 40 is a guess, not a rule. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.

The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one current PAYE tax configuration per employee

measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The employer's all-in spend for the run: gross earnings plus employer taxes (employer NI, Apprenticeship Levy) and employer-borne items. This is the number for 'what does payroll cost us' — total_pay is not (that is net take-home). Draft runs carry provisional values that change on every recalculation. measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The benefit value applied on this line; sums over a payslip reconcile to its total_benefits. It is not part of net pay and not part of gross, so it never belongs in a take-home or gross figure. Whether it belongs in employment cost depends on what the benefit type is — a contribution the employer funds is spend, a payrolled benefit value is not — so classify by benefit_type_id first and never sum this column into a cost number blind. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.

measures.label: payroll uk payslip deduction lines rows

measures.label: amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Money withheld from the employee on this line. Sums (within Posted runs) reconcile to the payslip's total_deductions. It is the employee's own money redirected — never add it to employer cost. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.

measures.label: rate per unit

Never SUM it; averaging across lines without weighting by number_of_units gives a meaningless 'average rate'. Null for Fixed-rate lines, which carry fixed_amount instead. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.

measures.label: amount

Sum across this table plus the leave and timesheet earnings tables to rebuild the payslip's gross_earnings; this family alone is not gross. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.

measures.label: payroll uk payslip employee tax lines rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one employee tax line per payslip per position in its employeeTaxLines array. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
