measures.label: amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Tax withheld on this component. Sums reconcile to the payslip's total_employee_taxes. Can be NEGATIVE for refunds (PAYE rebates after a tax code change) — do not filter negatives out or withheld totals overstate. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one employee tax line per payslip per position in its employeeTaxLines array

measures.label: payroll uk payslip employer tax lines rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one employer tax line per payslip per position in its employerTaxLines array. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one employer tax line per payslip per position in its employerTaxLines array

measures.label: amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Employer tax owed on this component — pure on-cost, additional to gross. Sums reconcile to the payslip's total_employer_taxes. Negative amounts are corrections; keep them in totals. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one employer tax line per payslip per position in its employerTaxLines array

measures.label: payroll uk payslip leave accrual lines rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one leave accrual line per payslip per position in its leaveAccrualLines array. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one leave accrual line per payslip per position in its leaveAccrualLines array

measures.label: number of units
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Entitlement units earned this run. Additive across runs per leave type, but it is accrual only — not net of leave taken, and not comparable across leave types with different units. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one leave accrual line per payslip per position in its leaveAccrualLines array

measures.label: payroll uk payslip leave earnings lines rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one leave earnings line per payslip per position in its leaveEarningsLines array. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one leave earnings line per payslip per position in its leaveEarningsLines array

measures.label: rate per unit
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Price per unit of leave. Input, never summed; for statutory leave this is the statutory rate, not the employee's ordinary pay. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one leave earnings line per payslip per position in its leaveEarningsLines array

measures.label: amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Money paid for this leave line. Part of gross_earnings — the 'cost of leave taken' measure, not an addition to payroll cost. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one leave earnings line per payslip per position in its leaveEarningsLines array

measures.label: payroll uk payslip payment lines rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one payment line per payslip per position in its paymentLines array. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one payment line per payslip per position in its paymentLines array

measures.label: amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Net pay routed to this bank account. Per payslip these sum to total_pay for Electronically paid slips — a residual is a reconciliation flag, not rounding to ignore. Never treat as earnings: it is cash routing. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payment line per payslip per position in its paymentLines array

measures.label: payroll uk payslip reimbursement lines rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one reimbursement line per payslip per position in its reimbursementLines array. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one reimbursement line per payslip per position in its reimbursementLines array

measures.label: amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Money repaid to the employee on this line — added to net pay, excluded from gross and tax. Sums reconcile to the payslip's total_reimbursements. Not compensation: exclude it from wage benchmarking. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one reimbursement line per payslip per position in its reimbursementLines array

measures.label: payroll uk payslip timesheet earnings lines rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one timesheet earnings line per payslip per position in its timesheetEarningsLines array. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one timesheet earnings line per payslip per position in its timesheetEarningsLines array

measures.label: rate per unit
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Price per timesheet unit. Input, never summed; weight by number_of_units for a true average rate. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one timesheet earnings line per payslip per position in its timesheetEarningsLines array

measures.label: number of units
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Timesheet units paid — the paid-hours measure for hourly workforces. Units are defined by the earnings rate; confirm before cross-rate sums. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one timesheet earnings line per payslip per position in its timesheetEarningsLines array

measures.label: amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Value of the timesheet-driven pay on this line. Part of gross_earnings; the third leg of the gross reconciliation with regular and leave earnings. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one timesheet earnings line per payslip per position in its timesheetEarningsLines array

measures.label: payroll uk payslips rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one payslip per employee per pay run. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip per employee per pay run

measures.label: total earnings
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Gross earnings before any deduction. For UK payroll the spec declares this IDENTICAL to gross_earnings (the pair exists for cross-region API symmetry). Use exactly one of the two — adding them doubles gross. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip per employee per pay run

measures.label: gross earnings
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Gross pay: the sum of the regular, leave and timesheet earnings families before tax and deductions. This is the base for employment cost (add total_employer_taxes) and the denominator for effective tax rate. Equals total_earnings for UK by definition. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip per employee per pay run

measures.label: total pay
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of NET take-home pay — gross minus employee taxes, deductions and court orders, plus reimbursements. The name reads like gross; it is not. 'Payroll cost' questions answered with SUM(total_pay) understate spend by the entire tax and on-cost wedge. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip per employee per pay run

measures.label: total employer taxes
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The employer's own tax on top of gross — employer (secondary Class 1) National Insurance and Apprenticeship Levy. It never reduces the employee's pay; it is pure employer cost. Per-head employment cost = gross_earnings + total_employer_taxes. Detail in xero_payroll_uk_payslip_employer_tax_lines. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip per employee per pay run

measures.label: total employee taxes
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Tax withheld FROM the employee: PAYE income tax plus employee (primary Class 1) NI. Withheld, not employer cost — do not add it to total_cost-style figures, it is already inside gross. Detail in xero_payroll_uk_payslip_employee_tax_lines. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip per employee per pay run

measures.label: total deductions
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Sum of the deductionLines family — employee pension contributions and other configured deductions subtracted from gross to reach net. Excludes statutory tax (that is total_employee_taxes) and court orders (their own total). Pre-tax vs post-tax character lives on the lines via subject_to_tax. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip per employee per pay run

measures.label: total reimbursements
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Non-taxable repayments of out-of-pocket expenses, ADDED to net pay. They are not earnings: including them in gross-pay or compensation analysis inflates wages with expense repayments. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip per employee per pay run

measures.label: total court orders
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Statutory attachment-of-earnings amounts (AEOs, child maintenance DEOs) the employer must divert from the employee's pay. Deducted after tax; part of the gross-to-net bridge but not an employer cost and not a voluntary deduction. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip per employee per pay run

measures.label: total benefits
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Value of the benefitLines family — employer-side, non-earnings compensation, per the spec's own definition (fringe benefits and perks provided in addition to normal earnings). It is outside the gross-to-net bridge: it is not in gross_earnings and not in total_pay, so it is never cash the employee received. Whether a given line is real employer spend (an employer contribution) or only a taxable value being payrolled depends entirely on how the org configured its benefit types — resolve that from xero_payroll_uk_payslip_benefit_lines before this total enters any cost figure. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one payslip per employee per pay run

measures.label: payroll uk reimbursements rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one reimbursement pay item per reimbursementID. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one reimbursement pay item per reimbursementID

measures.label: payroll uk settings accounts rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one payroll GL account mapping per payroll account role (type) for the organisation. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one payroll GL account mapping per payroll account role (type) for the organisation

measures.label: payroll uk statutory leave summaries rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one statutory leave episode per statutoryLeaveID. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one statutory leave episode per statutoryLeaveID

measures.label: payroll uk statutory sick leaves rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one statutory sick pay (SSP) episode per statutoryLeaveID. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one statutory sick pay (SSP) episode per statutoryLeaveID

measures.label: entitlement weeks remaining
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Calculated weeks left in the SSP period. The one field here that behaves like a balance — do not sum it across episodes of the same employee, linked episodes share one entitlement. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one statutory sick pay (SSP) episode per statutoryLeaveID

measures.label: payroll uk timesheet lines rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one timesheet line per timesheetLineID: one employee's units for one date and one earnings rate. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one timesheet line per timesheetLineID: one employee's units for one date and one earnings rate

measures.label: number of units
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Units worked on the line — additive, in the earnings rate's typeOfUnits (normally hours). The number payroll pays hourly staff from once the parent completes. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one timesheet line per timesheetLineID: one employee's units for one date and one earnings rate

measures.label: payroll uk timesheets rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one timesheet per timesheetID: one employee's submitted hours for one payroll-calendar period. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one timesheet per timesheetID: one employee's submitted hours for one payroll-calendar period

measures.label: total hours
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Header total of the line units. Equal to SUM(timesheet_lines.number_of_units) — adding both in a joined query doubles hours. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one timesheet per timesheetID: one employee's submitted hours for one payroll-calendar period

measures.label: payroll uk tracking categories rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one payroll tracking configuration record per organisation. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one payroll tracking configuration record per organisation

measures.label: prepayment allocations rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one application of prepayment credit to one invoice, keyed by parent prepayment and array position. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one application of prepayment credit to one invoice, keyed by parent prepayment and array position

measures.label: amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Credit applied to the invoice, in the DOCUMENT currency, up to 4dp. This is settlement, not revenue and not new cash: the cash event was the prepayment's source bank transaction. It reduces the invoice's AmountDue and the parent's remaining_credit by the same figure. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one application of prepayment credit to one invoice, keyed by parent prepayment and array position

measures.label: prepayments rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one prepayment credit document per PrepaymentID. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one prepayment credit document per PrepaymentID

measures.label: sub total
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Tax-exclusive total of the document in currency_code — always ex-tax regardless of line_amount_types. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one prepayment credit document per PrepaymentID

measures.label: total
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of sub_total + total_tax in currency_code: the full size of the credit when created. Compare with applied_amount and remaining_credit for its lifecycle; total never changes as credit is consumed. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one prepayment credit document per PrepaymentID

measures.label: currency rate
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Rate to the org's base currency at creation; the XE.com day rate when none was specified. Base-currency reporting multiplies monetary columns by this. A rate — never SUM it, and treat null as base currency (rate 1.0). The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one prepayment credit document per PrepaymentID

measures.label: remaining credit
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Unapplied credit RIGHT NOW — a current-state balance restated on every sync, not a historical measure. SUM across rows gives today's outstanding prepayment credit; never trend it over time from this table, and never expect total - applied_amount to equal it once cash refunds exist (refunds reduce credit via xero_payments, not allocations). The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one prepayment credit document per PrepaymentID

measures.label: project tasks rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one task (a billable or non-billable work item) on one project per taskId. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one task (a billable or non-billable work item) on one project per taskId

measures.label: rate value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Charge rate flattened from the rate Amount pair, in the project's currency: the per-hour price for TIME tasks, the fixed price for FIXED tasks, meaningless for NON_CHARGEABLE. Only multiply it by hours for TIME tasks — rate times minutes on a FIXED task manufactures revenue that will never be billed. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one task (a billable or non-billable work item) on one project per taskId

measures.label: total minutes
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of To-date balance of minutes logged against the task via time entries — it already equals the sum of this task's rows in xero_project_time_entries, so never add the two. Divide by 60.0 for hours; integer division floors. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one task (a billable or non-billable work item) on one project per taskId

measures.label: minutes invoiced
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Minutes on this task that have already been billed. With minutes_to_be_invoiced it splits chargeable logged time by billing state — the project header's minutes_to_be_invoiced is documented as covering chargeable tasks only, so do not expect NON_CHARGEABLE effort (which lands in non_chargeable_minutes) to appear in either half. On a FIXED task the fee, not the minutes, is what gets invoiced, so reconcile this pair against fixed_minutes before treating it as a billed-hours measure. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one task (a billable or non-billable work item) on one project per taskId

measures.label: minutes to be invoiced
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Chargeable minutes logged but not yet billed — the task-level WIP clock. The project header's minutes_to_be_invoiced is this summed across the project's chargeable tasks. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one task (a billable or non-billable work item) on one project per taskId

measures.label: fixed minutes
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Minutes logged against the task when its charge type is FIXED. These measure the effort spent delivering the fee, not billable value — cost-of-delivery and margin-on-fixed-fee questions live here, and pricing these minutes at rate double-charges the fee. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one task (a billable or non-billable work item) on one project per taskId

measures.label: non chargeable minutes
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Minutes logged when the charge type is NON_CHARGEABLE — where internal, goodwill and rework time accumulates. The chargeable-share utilization ratio uses this as the free component of the denominator; it carries zero billable value by definition. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one task (a billable or non-billable work item) on one project per taskId

measures.label: total amount value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Current chargeable value of the task in the project's currency: minutes times rate for TIME, the fee for FIXED, zero for NON_CHARGEABLE. The task-level analog of the project's total_task_amount — a Xero-maintained balance, not a transaction total. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one task (a billable or non-billable work item) on one project per taskId

measures.label: amount to be invoiced value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Chargeable value not yet billed for this task, in the project's currency. Sums (per project) to the header's task_amount_to_be_invoiced; 'what can we invoice' filters charge_type <> 'NON_CHARGEABLE' and sums this. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one task (a billable or non-billable work item) on one project per taskId

measures.label: amount invoiced value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Value of this task already billed, in the project's currency. No invoice ids accompany it — billing state in this API is a rollup, never a link to xero_invoices rows. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one task (a billable or non-billable work item) on one project per taskId

measures.label: project time entries rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one logged block of minutes by one user against one task per timeEntryId. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one logged block of minutes by one user against one task per timeEntryId

measures.label: duration
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Minutes logged — integer, and the domain's one additive measure. Postgres integer division floors: duration/60 loses up to 59 minutes per row, so write duration/60.0, or SUM the minutes first and divide once. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one logged block of minutes by one user against one task per timeEntryId

measures.label: project users rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one Xero user with access to Xero Projects in the org per userId. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero user with access to Xero Projects in the org per userId

measures.label: projects rows
measures.description: Count of source rows at the documented grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId. This is a discoverability measure, not a business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: minutes logged
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of To-date balance of ALL minutes logged across the project's tasks — chargeable, fixed-fee and non-chargeable alike. It already contains every row of xero_project_time_entries, so adding the two double-counts every hour. Divide by 60.0 for hours: Postgres integer division by 60 silently floors. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: minutes to be invoiced
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Chargeable minutes not yet invoiced across the project's tasks — the time-side WIP counter. Non-chargeable minutes never enter it, so on mixed projects this is NOT minutes_logged minus invoiced minutes. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: total task amount value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Current chargeable value of all the project's tasks in currency_code: logged time priced at task rates for TIME tasks plus the fees of FIXED tasks; NON_CHARGEABLE work contributes zero however many hours it burned. A balance Xero recomputes as time is logged — not a transaction total, and not addable to sums built from the task or time-entry tables. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: total expense amount value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Current value of expenses recorded on the project, in currency_code. The public Projects API exposes no expense endpoint, so this rollup and its invoiced/uninvoiced split are the ONLY view of project expenses — there is no child table to reconcile against and no expense-level detail to drill into. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: estimate value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of The project's budget, flattened from the estimate Amount pair, in currency_code. Budget-vs-actual compares it against total_task_amount + total_expense_amount. Null means nobody set a budget — treat as 'no estimate', never as zero, or every unestimated project looks catastrophically over budget. The spec publishes no description for this field or for estimateAmount and offers no formula relating them: read the two as one budget, report this one, and never sum both. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: task amount to be invoiced value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Chargeable task value not yet invoiced, in currency_code; with task_amount_invoiced it splits total_task_amount by billing state. Use it for the task-only slice of WIP and quote total_to_be_invoiced as the headline billable figure — the spec documents no formula linking them, so reconcile the pair on a real tenant rather than assuming one is the other minus expenses. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: task amount invoiced value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Task value already billed, in currency_code. Billing state in this API is only ever a rollup — the payload carries no invoice ids, so this cannot be decomposed into rows of xero_invoices. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: expense amount to be invoiced value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Billable expense value not yet invoiced, in currency_code. With no expense child endpoint, this rollup is as granular as expense WIP gets. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: expense amount invoiced value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Expense value already billed to the client, in currency_code. Pairs with expense_amount_to_be_invoiced to split total_expense_amount's billable portion by billing state. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: project amount invoiced value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Invoiced value carried against the project to date, in currency_code. The spec documents neither this field nor total_invoiced, and the two can disagree on projects that used deposits or credit notes — quote total_invoiced as the billed-to-date headline, and use deposit, deposit_applied and credit_note_amount to account for any gap. Reporting the difference between the two as a business quantity, without that reconciliation, invents a number nothing in the API defines. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: deposit value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Deposit taken up-front on the project, flattened from the deposit Amount pair, in currency_code. A deposit is money billed ahead of delivery, so on deposit-heavy projects billed-to-date runs ahead of work performed and earned-value questions must net it against deposit_applied. Xero documents no formula, so do not assert whether total_invoiced already contains it — reconcile the two on the tenant's own data before mixing them in one answer. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: deposit applied value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Portion of the deposit already drawn down against later invoicing, in currency_code. deposit minus deposit_applied is the deposit still to be offset — money the client has paid for that has not yet been matched to delivered work, and the reason a project's billed total can move without any new task or expense being invoiced. Undocumented in the spec like the rest of the deposit mechanics, so use it to explain gaps, not to derive other columns. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: credit note amount value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Value credited back against the project's invoicing — corrections, write-offs and refunded billing — in currency_code. It is why a project can legitimately show less invoiced than the sum of its invoiced tasks and expenses, so check it (with the deposit pair) before reporting an invoicing discrepancy. A to-date balance, not a list: no credit-note ids travel with it, so it cannot be tied back to rows in the accounting domain. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: total invoiced value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Headline billed-to-date balance in currency_code and the number to quote for 'how much has this project billed'. Xero publishes no formula for it: it will not reliably equal task_amount_invoiced + expense_amount_invoiced wherever deposits or credit notes are in play, so explain the difference through deposit, deposit_applied and credit_note_amount instead of reverse-engineering the column. It is a rollup, not a ledger — the payload carries no invoice ids, so it can never be tied to specific xero_invoices rows. Cross-project sums must respect currency_code. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: total to be invoiced value
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Headline uninvoiced-value balance — Xero's own answer to 'what could this project bill now', in currency_code, and the right single number for unbilled WIP by project or client. The spec documents no composition, so take it as given rather than deriving it as task_amount_to_be_invoiced + expense_amount_to_be_invoiced; the two part company wherever a deposit is still to be applied. Filter status = 'INPROGRESS' or long-closed projects carrying residual balances distort the pipeline. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one Xero Projects project (a client job) per projectId

measures.label: purchase order line items rows

measures.grain: one line item on one purchase order

measures.label: quantity
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Units ordered; null on description-only lines. Xero records no goods-receipt event or received quantity anywhere in the accounting API — ordered-vs-received gaps are unanswerable from this connector, and this column must never be read as 'delivered'. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one line item on one purchase order

measures.label: unit amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Per-unit price in the order's currency. GET /PurchaseOrders exposes no unitdp parameter, so unlike Items and Receipts this arrives at Xero's default 2dp and cannot be requested at 4dp — quantity * unit_amount can therefore differ from line_amount by rounding, and line_amount is the authoritative extended value. A rate, never a total: average unit prices only when weighted by quantity. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one line item on one purchase order

measures.label: line amount
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Extended line value after discounts, in the document currency. Includes tax only when the parent's line_amount_types = 'Inclusive' — tax-exclusive rollups need CASE WHEN Inclusive THEN line_amount - tax_amount ELSE line_amount END, or mixed-mode sums double-count tax. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one line item on one purchase order

measures.label: purchase orders rows

measures.label: currency rate
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Rate from this order's currency_code to the org's base currency, fixed at the document date (Xero falls back to the XE.com day rate when the user does not supply one). Base-currency value is total * currency_rate — dividing inverts the conversion and silently produces the wrong magnitude. It is a rate: SUM or AVG over this column is meaningless, and it is 1 on orders already in the base currency. The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.
measures.grain: one purchase order document raised against one supplier contact

measures.label: sub total
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Order total excluding tax, always normalized regardless of line_amount_types — the safe tax-exclusive measure for committed spend in the document currency. measures.label: total

The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.

measures.label: sub total

measures.label: total tax
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Tax that will be charged on ONE generated occurrence of the template, in the template's currency_code — not a per-month or lifetime figure. Projecting recurring tax liability requires normalizing by schedule_unit/schedule_period first, exactly like sub_total; and a DRAFT-status template accrues nothing, so committed-tax projections must filter status = 'AUTHORISED'. Actual tax charged lives on the generated invoices' total_tax in xero_invoices, which wins whenever the two disagree (users edit generated drafts). The aggregation is constrained by the documented source grain and is not a certified business KPI.

measures.label: total

measures.label: schedule period
measures.description: Exploratory aggregation of Multiplier on schedule_unit: 1 + WEEKLY = every week, 2 + MONTHLY = every 2 months. measures.grain: one repeating invoice template per RepeatingInvoiceID
